question: In today’s world, people spend a lot of money on appearance because they want to look younger. Why does this happen? Do you think this is a positive or negative development?
essay:
In today’s world, many people spend a large amount of money on their appearance because they want to look younger. This trend is mainly caused by social pressure and the influence of media and celebrities. In my opinion, this is largely a negative development because it can create financial pressure and reduce people’s self-confidence.

One major reason for this trend is social pressure. Many people feel that they need to look young and attractive in order to be accepted by others. This is because social media and celebrities often show ideal images of beauty. For example, people may see famous actors or influencers who appear younger than their real age. As a result, they may spend money on cosmetics, skincare products or beauty treatments.

I believe this is a negative development for several reasons. First, people may spend too much money on products or treatments that they do not really need. This can create financial pressure, especially for those with a limited income. In addition, focusing too much on appearance may reduce self-confidence. For instance, some people may feel unhappy with their natural appearance because they compare themselves with celebrities online. Therefore, this trend can have both financial and emotional effects.

In conclusion, people often spend money to look younger because of social pressure and the influence of media. In my view, this is a negative development because it can lead to unnecessary spending and lower self-confidence.

question: MANY STUDENTS GRADUATE HIGH SCHOOL AND THEN WANT TO CONTINUE THEIR STUDIES IN ANOTHER COUNTRY. GIVE THE ADVANTAGES AND DISADVANTAGES OF STUDYING ABROAD.
essay:
The place in which a person studies  is very important. After graduation, many students prefer not to continue their studies in their home country. They choose to travel abroad. This essay will examine the advantages and the disadvantages of studying abroad.

There are several advantages to studying abroad. First, other countries could provide better education. Moreover, they could have improved universities with great teachers. Students deserve to have a better way of learning. Second, travelling abroad helps explore a different environment. In addition, discovering a new place to study  with a different atmosphere is super fun. Being in the same country can be extremely boring. Finally, this provides an opportunity to meet new people.  Also, they could help each other with studying. Having new friends improves the mental health of a student.

However, studying abroad does have multiple disadvantages. First, it sometimes causes loneliness. Moreover, being far from family affects health negatively. Not having a sibling or relative to talk to is hard. Second, it is a massive responsibility. In addition, there are numerous things that students are responsible for abroad. They have to take care of food, laundry, rent, and much more, which is difficult. Finally, language difference is a major issue for many students. Also, not being able to talk to literally everyone is a problem that they always face. This makes communication, which is really important, extremely hard.

In conclusion, it is clear to see that travelling abroad has numerous advantages, such as improved education, exploring new environments, and meeting friends. However, it does have various disadvantages. Loneliness, big responsibility, and language differences are just some of the problems

question: Nowadays, it is easier for young people to have a credit card compared to the past. Do the advantages of this trend outweigh the disadvantages?
essay:
The conditions of having a credit card have become more convenient for young people in recent years, whereas banks implemented very strict rules in the past. While there are some drawbacks, the upsides of promoting credit cards to young individuals in an easy way,such as exclusive offers from supermarkets and online shops can far outweigh its downsides, such as the risk of having huge financial debts. This essay will elaborate on both sides with relevant arguments and examples.

On the one hand, some supermarket chains and online stores offer considerable discounts for credit card users, while cash payers cannot access them. They collaborate with some global card companies, such as Visa and MasterCard, encouraging card users to shop at their stores by decreasing their products' prices at a noticeable level. To illustrate, Costco, which is a well-known supermarket chain, provides significant discounts and payback options for Visa holders, which is particularly useful for students who cannot afford to buy expensive food at full price. As a result, these collaborations provide considerable price advantages for young adults when they use their credit cards at partnership stores.

On the other hand, having financial freedom at a young age can lead to serious debt problems. Since they can easily obtain many credit cards from different banks, such as RBC and TD, they spend too much money due to limited financial experience. For instance, banks provide a credit card limit of 1,000 CAD, enabling young adults to spend this money without any restriction. Thus, they may spend their entire limit at once and face a serious debt problem.

In conclusion, although easily obtaining a credit card has some disadvantages, I firmly maintain that upsides far outweigh the risk of serious debt because a credit card provides an affordable shopping experience for young adults who have limited budgets.

question: Online communication is becoming more popular than face-to-face communication in many companies. Do the advantages of this outweigh its disadvantages?
essay:
In this modern era, various forms of communication have become one of the most acute problems to the general public. While some people argue that online communication in numerous enterprises benefits overshadow in person type, I partly agree with this opinion. This essay aims to provide a comprehensive analysis of both arguments before offering my final conclusion.

Examining online communication, it is time-saving and saves money. Firstly, apps like Zoom or Google Meet allow employees to text or call instantly without leaving their desks. This helps companies cut down on travel expenses and focus more on work. Furthermore, digital tools make remote working possible. People from different countries can work together on the same project easily without traveling. For example, an employee in Vietnam can join a meeting with a manager in America at any time.

In contrast, in person interperson includes pivotal benefits that cannot be replaced. To begin with, it contributes to avoid misunderstandings. When people meet in person, they can see body language and facial expressions, which makes the message clearer. Moreover, talking face-to-face is the best way to build trust and better relationships among colleagues and managers. This is due to the fact that workers are able to feel more connected when they talk during lunch or coffee breaks, which leads to the betterment of cooperation and teamwork.

In conclusion, online communication is extremely useful for daily tasks and global teamwork. However, it should not replace face-to-face interaction completely. In my opinion, companies should strike a balance between both methods to get the best results.

question: Some people have decided to reduce the number of times they fly every year or to stop flying altogether. Do you think the environmental benefits of this development outweigh the disadvantages for individuals and businesses? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
essay:
It is often argued that reducing air travel could help protect the environment. Some people believe this shift brings clear environmental benefits, while others think the disadvantages for individuals and businesses outweigh these gains. In my opinion, the drawbacks are more significant than the environmental advantages.

One major disadvantage is the impact on businesses that rely on international travel. This is because many companies depend on face-to-face meetings to build client relationships and close deals. As a result, replacing flights with video calls can slow down business operations and reduce efficiency. For example, a company negotiating a contract abroad may lose the deal to a competitor willing to travel in person. This shows that reducing flights can directly harm business performance.

Another important factor is the effect on individuals, particularly those with family or personal ties abroad. This is largely due to the fact that flying is often the only realistic way to visit relatives living in distant countries. Consequently, reducing flights can mean fewer opportunities to maintain close family relationships. For instance, someone with parents living overseas may only be able to visit them once every few years instead of annually. This demonstrates that flying reductions can create real personal hardship, not just inconvenience.

In conclusion, I believe the disadvantages of reducing flights outweigh the environmental benefits, because both businesses and individuals depend heavily on air travel for essential activities that are difficult to replace.

question: Taking risks in both professional and personal life is important. Do you think the advantages of taking risks outweigh the disadvantages? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
essay:
Whether to take risks in life has become a topic of debate. Although taking risks in personal and professional life can lead to stress and uncertainty, the positive results will make your life meaningful and euphoric. I think taking risks has its own drawbacks, but their outcomes are more  reliable and outshines its demerits.

Firstly, research has shown that people who take  risks in their lives can achieve their goals eventually. For instance, the entrepreneurs work really hard and invest in new technologies and ideas. In the start, they faced many hurdles and rejections, but still they stuck to their plan or do some manipulative decisions and succeed at the end. Secondly, in personal life, taking risksrisks can encourage and broaden horizons. For example, students who choose to study abroad  initially can feel daunting and lonely. But after experiencing these issues can lead to self-confidence and maturity.

Admittedly, risks can lead to financial loss, stress, or failures, but these disadvantages are temporary and can give you  great and long-term success in the future. For instance, a failed business can be rearranged in a new way by changing the strategies and overcoming more hardships. The potential rewards of risk-taking surpass the drawbacks.

In conclusion, although  taking risks in life can lead to failures and stress, the output after hurdles can lead to success and new learnings eventually. By being stagnant, no one can innovate or  change their lives. Instead, try, fail and try again with new efforts can reward you with greater outputs. Surely, taking risks outweighs the disadvantages.

question: These days, if people have health problems, many do not visit doctors. They try to get better at home by themselves. Is this a positive or negative development?
essay:
Nowadays, some people prefer to treat themselves at home instead of visiting a doctor when they are ill. Although this may not be problematic for a common cold, in severe cases, this can worsen the situation. Thus, I believe this is generally a negative development.

Most people do not possess the medical knowledge required to diagnose and treat illnesses properly. In order to recover effectively, a patient first needs to undergo appropriate examinations so that the actual condition can be identified. Only then, they can be prescribed medications to specifically target the cause. Healthcare professionals spend years of education and professional training to develop the knowledge and skills needed for diagnosis and treatment. Self-treatment however, ignores this important process and may lead people to rely on remedies that are unsuitable for their actual condition.

Furthermore, not all conditions can be cured by the body’s natural immune system. In fact, if someone is developing the symptoms related to a serious condition, relying on ineffective remedies and rest equals ignoring the condition entirely. This, by allowing the cause to develop symptoms with no barrier to disrupt its mechanism, can put the patient in a dangerous situation. By visiting a healthcare practitioner and checking the signs of their illness, people can ensure that they are not overlooking it, and also not delaying treatment.

To conclude, although it is seen that some tend to use different methods of self-treatment at home, it is undeniably not an appropriate practice as by doing so a patient is giving the disease an opportunity to grow, sometimes in silence.Therefore, visiting a doctor is the most reasonable choice when sick.

question: These days, many university courses are offered through the internet. Some people think that online teaching has more advantages than conventional classroom teaching or lectures, while others claim that there are significant disadvantages. Do the benefits of online teaching outweigh the disadvantages?
essay:
In recent years, online teaching has become increasingly common at universities. Although this development has certain drawbacks, I believe that the advantages outweigh the disadvantages, primarily because online teaching saves commuting time, offers flexibility, and provides people with the opportunity to pursue their education.

On the one hand, there are several drawbacks associated with online education. One notable drawback of this trend is that it reduces face-to-face interaction. This is because taking online courses does not provide students with the same environment that they experience on campus. For instance, offline classes provide them with a chance to meet their peers in the classroom and in the cafeteria, where they get an opportunity to make new friends. As a result, some students may experience feelings of isolation, as they cannot easily discuss their educational problems with their peers, making it more difficult for them to cope with academic stress. Consequently, online classes negatively affect their social and communication skills.

On the other hand, I believe that the advantages are more significant. The primary one is that online learning saves students' commuting time. This is particularly important for them because university students can use this time for other productive activities, such as completing assignments or revising their course material. For example, students living far from the university save a lot of travelling time. The second advantage is that it also provides full-time and part-time workers with an opportunity to pursue their studies. This is because online classes allow them to work alongside their studies. Moreover, having the flexibility to organise their work and studies at the same time is a major benefit for students taking online university courses.

In conclusion, although there are some disadvantages, such as a lack of communication and person-to-person interactions, I believe that the advantages of online courses outweigh the disadvantages because students have the opportunity to pursue further studies and save travel time.

question: University students are increasingly studying abroad as part of their studies. Do the advantages of studying abroad overweighs the disadvantages?
essay:
The number of students studying abroad has increased significantly, as this is related to their studies. I believe that the advantages of this phenomenon outweigh the disadvantages, which I will elaborate on in my essay below.

Looking first at the merits, we can believe that studying abroad is actually one of many opportunities to develop the skills we have, since many people nowadays feel that their home universities tend not to offer the lessons that companies need. For instance, Indonesia's top-ten universities still do not conduct social data science, which is the study of artificial intelligence in human behaviour, political trends, and public policy. In addition, studying abroad might increase human resources, especially for those who graduate from prestigious universities. These institutions tend to strictly supervise students to be serious in their studies. This could be by giving them a variety of assignments in order to gain insight into almost everything around the world. As a result, once they come home, they easily dominate the conversation among people and understand every aspect and the connections.

Moving to the demerits, it appears that the nationality issue can be seen as the primary drawback of this situation. People who move overseas to study and already have a distinguished career find that they do not want to come back to their home country, since leaving the place they live in means they must leave their prestigious and long-lasting career, high monthly salary, and luxurious life to enhance their neighbourhood communities and start from the very beginning.Moreover, some people tend to have mental issues caused by cultural adaptation, in which sometimes other cultures do not resonate with those people, making them feel out of place and divided. As a result, they are not able to find a connection for a bright career.

To conclude, while some demerits must be considered such as the nationality problem and mental health, it seems that the advantages through opportunities and increasing human resources are so lucrative. This leads each individual to realise that studying abroad can be a better option.

question: Globalization has become a major phenomenon in the modern world, affecting culture, economy, and social norms. Some people believe that globalization brings more advantages than disadvantages, while others argue that it has negative effects on cultural identity and diversity. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essay:
Nowadays, globalisation has become part of our lives and has an impact on several aspects of society. Some people think globalisation has more benefits, whereas others believe that it has negative impacts on culture. In my opinion, I believe that the benefits of globalisation are greater than the negative effects.

On the one hand, some people believe that globalisation has many benefits for society. This is because it provides individuals with more opportunities, which improve people’s quality of life. For example, people can gain job opportunities or study in other countries. Also, it helps companies enter new markets, which can support economic growth and provide  new jobs. This may reduce unemployment and help families earn a stable income.  As a result, they can enhance their quality of life and build a better future.

On the other hand, others believe that globalisation has a negative impact on local cultures. This is because people may be  influenced by other cultures and start losing their identity, habits, and traditions. For instance, young people may copy the clothes or lifestyle of other cultures instead of following their own local culture. In addition, the spread of movies, music, and fashion may make younger generations less interested in traditional clothes or local habits. Therefore, some local traditions may gradually disappear over time.

In conclusion, although globalisation may have a negative impact on local cultures, I believe that it has many benefits because it provides  better  opportunities  for people.

question: Having more money and less free time is better than earning less money and having more free time. Some people think that high salary is important when choosing a company to work for, while other think that good working atmosphere is more important, Discuss both views and state your opinion.
essay:
Some individuals believe that a high salary is crucial when choosing a company to work for, while others think that a good working environment is more important. I strongly agree that a high salary is more important because it can provide a comfortable lifestyle and avoid asking others for financial help.

On the one hand, a peaceful working environment can be considered as a backbone for many employees and prefer to feel secure rather than getting more money, which helps them to develop their skills in a quiet way. In addition, a positive working atmosphere can retain an employee for a long period of time. For example, in Saudi Arabia, 70% from the citizens choose to work as a teacher with low income in stable conditions rather than working as bankers with high salaries and stressful atmosphere.

On the other hand, working for a company with a stable and high salary is important because it can provide a comfortable and fulfilling lifestyle in many aspects of life , such as health and education and avoid asking people for financial assistance, rather than working in a good atmosphere. Moreover, high salaries can create a respectful life for employees and their families through the level of education and healthcare services. For instance, in the UK, 60 per cent of civilians have a high level of education as a result of high salary intake.

In conclusion, although working in a positive and secure environment is better than getting more money, I believe it is more beneficial to have a consistent and high salary, especially when it is reflecting on your lifestyle.

question: Many peole think that it is important to go to university while others prefer to start work without getting a universty education. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
In the modern era, so many people choose to pursue further study after completing high studies, while others want to start their career right after that. In this essay, I am going to discuss  both the views and give my opinion in the last.

On the one hand, students who have completed their high school education choose to start a job. Firstly, the experience which they gain from the job is more practical than the study. So, people want to embark on their career to get the real knowledge of the market. Secondly, they will learn  tactics for  unpredictable problems and get used to the office environment. For example, people who work in the marketing department get the practical knowledge of the strategies and planning which is not possible in the university.

On the other hand, students who choose to study further after completing  higher education  become clearer about their future goals. In addition, tertiary education has seminars, part-time work opportunities and various projects which teach them to gain  real-time knowledge about the situations. Moreover, they learn time management, leadership skills and other necessary skills from the college education , which helps them to perform better in the future. For instance, from the survey of 2021, 70% of the students who completed their high studies chose to pursue higher education to develop skills in the particular subjects.

In a nutshell, there are convincing arguments for and against pursuing higher education. However, I strongly believe that persuing the university degree is more helpful to choose the right path in their career.

question: Some people believe that advertising is useful and informative while others believe it provides false information in order to increase the price of products and services. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion
essay:
It is an irrefutable fact that marketing of products through advertisements plays a significant role in increasing companies’ sales. While some people argue that the promotional campaigns provide false details about the products and services to boost their value, others reject this notion and believe that advertising is useful for product awareness to the public. I totally agree with the latter view.

Many people are of the view that the promotional events create demand for products and services by exaggerating their features, which eventually helps raise their selling price to the consumers. The promoters use cutting-edge technology to give their product a flashy look. Additionally, they also hire a reputed celebrity to promote their brand to influence a sizeable population to make their product and services more valuable. For example, when my friend launched his drink in the market, he could not sell much because he was not promoting it through any channel. As a result, people treated it as a normal drink and avoided buying it. On the other hand, when he started promoting his drink as the best hydration drink in the country, even though the drink was just a normal drink and he hired a famous cricketer to create hype among people, his sales figures drastically changed. Thus, advertising has a profound impact on the product value in the market. However, I believe that without ads, there is no way to receive the required information about what is available at shops.

I take the side of the people who support the perspective that commercial ads offer the public the necessary information required for making their buying decision. People can easily prepare the spending budget if they are provided with a price estimation of relevant consumer goods and services. Moreover, in order to select the best suitable product, they cannot afford to visit every store to inquire about the price and features of an item they need at home. Thus, offering all the information such as price, feature, and warranty period through ads saves customers’ time, energy and money that they will spend while exploring  it at different stores and locations. For example, household women refer Television adds to check the weekly sales at grocery stores and then choose the best place to buy their groceries. Therefore, the advertisements supply much-needed information for the public.  

In conclusion, although people strongly argue that promotional content gives manipulated information about items and facilities,  I believe it offers vital and essential details. This is the reason that an individual refers to advertisements to make his or her decision before spending money on an item.

question: Some people say that history offers no practical benefit to society while others claim that history teaches us to understand the present. Discuss both views and give your own opinion .
essay:
Certainly! Here's a strong and comprehensive IELTS essay on the topic, using advanced vocabulary, clear structure, and balanced argumentation:

Some people say that history offers no practical benefit to society while others claim that history teaches us to understand the present. Discuss both views and give your own opinion

The value of history is a subject of enduring debate, often eliciting contrasting perspectives. While some argue that history holds no practical significance for modern society, others maintain that it is crucial for comprehending the complexities of the present. Both views present compelling points, yet I firmly believe that history is indispensable in shaping our understanding of the world today.

On one hand, critics contend that history is largely irrelevant in practical terms. They argue that the rapid pace of modern technological advancements and scientific discoveries renders historical knowledge obsolete. For instance, learning about ancient civilizations or outdated ideologies may seem disconnected from solving contemporary problems such as climate change or economic instability. Moreover, in an age where innovation and future-oriented thinking dominate, dwelling on past events might be perceived as a waste of time or resources. This school of thought prioritizes applicable skills and knowledge that directly address current challenges rather than reflective or theoretical insights from history.

Conversely, proponents of history emphasize its essential role in helping society make sense of present circumstances. By examining historical events, patterns, and decisions, individuals and communities can glean invaluable lessons that prevent the repetition of past mistakes. For example, understanding the causes and consequences of past wars or economic crises can inform better policies and international relations today. Additionally, history fosters cultural identity and awareness by connecting people to their heritage, traditions, and shared experiences. This connection not only strengthens social cohesion but also cultivates empathy and critical thinking. Without a historical framework, the present might appear fragmented, lacking context and meaning.

In my opinion, history is far more than a mere record of bygone eras; it is a dynamic tool for interpreting current realities and guiding future actions. While it might not provide immediate solutions like technology or science, it equips society with perspective and wisdom that are fundamental for sustainable progress. Ignoring history risks repeating errors and losing sight of the values that have shaped civilization.

In conclusion, although history might seem impractical to some in today’s fast-moving world, its benefits in understanding and navigating the present are undeniable. A balanced approach that integrates historical knowledge with contemporary innovation is essential for holistic development.

question: Some people say that in the digital age, theatres and cinemas are no longer important as people can watch all the entertainment they want online. Others argue that theatres and cinemas are still important both economically and culturally. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion. Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
essay:
In recent times, there have been a lot of discussions about many individuals who think that in the modern era, the use of theatres and cinemas is no longer crucial for people, as they have access to online platforms so that they can watch entertainment free of cost. Whereas, others disagree with this statement and say that they will both be vital in view of economic and cultural growth.

Many responses support the idea of watching movies on online platforms rather than visiting cinema halls in person. It will help with money management. Also, sitting on a couch will provide more comfort  than the theatres. Likewise, there is no time limit to watch a movie. They can have access to it very easily. For instance, people can watch their favourite movie at any time without any interruption in between and with more relaxation.

Other people might disagree and say that it will play an indispensable role in growth factors and traditional sides. As, the number of bookings in cinema halls gave profit to the government in economic rate. Moreover, films also play an impactful role in cultural areas. To epitomise, multiple cultures are shown in films in a wide variety so that people get to know about different forms of religions and traditions. Apart from that, it will also increase the financial standards of higher authorities by applying tax on the movies.

To recapitulate, both will have equal weightage. But, digital technology is gaining more popularity as it will be available at any time without booking or travelling. A person can catch it with ease at their home without  any disturbance.

question: Some people think that it's good for a country's culture if people watch some imported film or TV programs while some people argue that it could be better if people watch films of their own culture. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essay:
In the contemporary digital epoch, preserving the distinctive identity of individual ethnic groups has emerged as a paramount concern. The relentless march of technological innovation has effectively dismantled geographical frontiers, rendering cultural cross-pollination virtually inevitable. While a segment of society contends that consuming imported cinematographic and television content yields profound cognitive and social dividends for citizens, others maintain that prioritizing domestic media is indispensable for safeguarding national heritage and fostering socioeconomic growth. This essay will critically evaluate both dimensions of the debate before presenting a nuanced conclusion.

On the one hand, exposure to international media is an inescapable reality that can significantly broaden a population's horizons. In an increasingly globalized world, modern communication technologies have democratized access to foreign entertainment, making any protectionist censorship both impractical and counterproductive. For instance, the global hegemony of the English language over recent decades has not merely acted as a linguistic bridge, but has also facilitated the exchange of universal human values through cinema. Embracing such external cultural artifacts allows a citizenry to cultivate cosmopolitan perspectives, which ultimately drives national progress by fostering innovation, tolerance, and adaptability within the workforce.

On the counterparts, the unmitigated influx of foreign media can be perceived as an existential threat to local customs, morals, and linguistic traditions. Proponents of this view assert that a state's primary cultural mandate should be the stewardship and promotion of its indigenous creative industries. A nation’s collective identity is fundamentally anchored in its unique historical narratives and artistic expressions; while Western or mainstream global media may wield unmatched commercial dominance, it lacks the intrinsic authenticity and historical resonance found in traditional localized dramas. Ergo, actively nurturing a robust domestic film sector ensures that irreplaceable cultural legacies survive and thrive amidst the pressures of global homogeneity.

In conclusion, although both paradigms possess compelling justifications, I firmly believe that the integration of foreign television programs and films is overwhelmingly advantageous. Rather than eroding local values, the consumption of international media enriches the domestic cultural fabric, fostering cross-cultural empathy and global harmony while concurrently equipping citizens with a broader, more inclusive worldview.

question: Some people think that strict punishment for driving offences is key to reducing traffic accidents. Others however believe that other measures would improve road safety. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
It is an irrefutable fact that road accidents have become a growing concern in recent years. While some people argue that a strong punishment is the most effective solution to reduce traffic accidents, others reject this notion and emphasise other ways to enhance road safety. I totally agree with the former view because the traffic safety guidelines are more effective when drivers take them seriously due to the fear of punishment.

Many people are of the view that revamping the traffic system and developing road infrastructure may help reduce road crashes. To elaborate, installation of traffic lights at shorter intervals can be an effective way to minimise the chances of  overspeeding, which is one of the prominent reasons for causing road collisions. Furthermore, repairing potholes, which more often cause road accidents, can be a prudent strategy to improve road safety. However, I disagree with this view because all efforts are more likely to be in vain if vehicle drivers neglect their civic sense and ignore public safety while are driving.

I take the side of the people who support the perspective that a stronger punishment will play a significant role in reducing vehicle accidents on roads. Rash driving, drink and drive, and crossing the red light are some major reasons for hitting  people walking or driving on roads. A stern punishment for these offences will create fear among people , and they will pay serious attention to traffic rules. To exemplify, in countries such as the UAE have implemented heavy penalties and loss of driving license for violating traffic rules, which resulted in making people driving carefully and the number of road accidents have drastically decreased. Thus, a harsh punishment is a more effective solution to minimise road accidents.

In conclusion, although some people strongly argue that improving road conditions and installing more traffic lights could be a vital step to avoid traffic accidents, I believe taking  strict legal action against traffic rule violators will be a more prudent way to deal with this problem.

question: some people think that the government should provide free public libraries in every town, while others think this is a waste of money because people can get access the information on the internet. Discuss both these views and give own opinion.
essay:
In recent an era, online is available for every individual looking for information. public free libraries in every city iare often a subject of debate, with Some arguing  offering them for free is a waste of public funds, while others, including myself, believe they are crucial and should be stayed for no cost to the public. In my view, free public libraries provide essential rules to support those who lack the resources to access information otherwise.

Citizens argue that in an era where the internet is widely accessible, having public libraries is an inefficient use of money. They claim that individuals with higher socioeconomic status can easily afford personal devices, internet connections, and books, making libraries redundant for their needs. For instance, a friend of mine never visited the library because he had all the resources—such as the latest textbooks and fast internet—available at home. Moreover,  from his perspective, public libraries seemed unnecessary.

However, this view fails to consider the needs of economically disadvantaged individuals. Many people, particularly students, rely on public libraries as their only source of free access to educational materials, computers, and the Internet. Without these resources, their ability to excel academically would be severely limited. I personally experienced this during my university years when I had no internet access or computer at home. The local library provided me with the necessary tools to complete my studies, and without it, I would have struggled to graduate and improve my financial situation.

In conclusion, while some believe that funding public libraries is a waste, I strongly contend that these institutions are a critical investment. They provide equal access to knowledge and opportunities, especially for those who cannot afford alternatives, ultimately contributing to societal progress.

question: Art classes such as painting or drawing are important for children's development, so it should be compulsory in high school. Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
These days, art degrees, such as painting and drawing, can play an important role in children's lives. This essay will discuss and will explain the reasons why I disagree that this schedule should be compulsory for high school, since conscription has different interests and personalities.

On the one hand, artistry classes can provide several benefits for young people. Painting and drawing can develop creativity and help children to express their thoughts and emotions in the arts. In addition, these lessons may improve concentration and patience, as students have to pay attention to small details. And, it helps people to escape from their daily problems and relax after a hard period of studying. Therefore , learning subjects like this can contribute to children's concentration and development.

On the other hand, I do not think art classes are compulsory for every high school student. First of all, not every student is interested in art lessons, so they may feel bored or lose motivation during these lessons. They may prefer to spend more time on special subjects such as math, science or languages, since subjects like these may be more beneficial for their future career or education. Moreover, a compulsory artistry degree may take up students' time that would be spent on other important educational programs. Therefore, encouraging all students to study craft may not be the best way to improve their development.

In conclusion, although art classes can develop creativity and concentration, I do not believe that art classes should be compulsory in high school. Because, they do not have enough time to spend on subjects like these due to necessary lessons.

question: Full time university students spend most of the time studying. They should be doing other activities too. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Full time study in university is a great experience in life but in parallel to that students become inactive in other activities such as working for their pocket money, sports, participating in debates and socialization . People differ in their opinion if students must engaged in other things or stay concentrated on their studies only. The discussion will be presented below, followed by my opinion.

Some people say that mere studying does not product an overall youth for a country. This way, students only earn theoretical knowledge -- not practical. For instance, students can be intelligent during their studies but at the same time when they come in the market to work n , they fail and cannot develop their confidence and work as brilliantly as they were in university. Hence, the best approach for them need to be engaged here and there for practical experience.

On the other hand, others believe that building a better career is the foremost thing in today’s world. So, they are targeted to their studies and gain as much knowledge as they can. Furthermore, if they are diverted from their studies, they will not be able to make their target .

In my point of view, there must be blending of full time education and extra activities. It refreshes students’ minds and provides more energy to concentrate on it . Moreover, by this way, they will learn how to be mingled with other people in the society.

To summarize, it can be said that it is important to concentrate on study but on the other hand there must be something to keep them active and relaxed being involved in games, music, work and other extra activities.

question: In many countries children are engaged in some kind of paid work. Some people regard this as completely wrong, while others consider it to be a valuable work experience, which is important for learning and taking responsibility. What is your opinion on this?
essay:
In the Third World, children are usually sent to factories for laborious work. Many people believe that it is merely exploitation, while others think it is a good opportunity for them to have life experience. In any case, children have their right to live and study in peaceful conditions. Therefore, using them as workforce is considered an unacceptable action.

First of all, children are not workers. They have just learned about the vast world and do not have any experience or concept of working. Since these innocent children are naive and lack of life experiences , they can be easily cheated and exploited. There are many examples of this in poor nations. Because using children is cheap and easily to control, many enterprises hire them and don’t pay them much. Although the government in these countries has tried its best, this kind of taking advantage of children cannot be eliminated.

In conclusion, since all children are the great concern of parent and society, they should be allowed to enjoy life and educated rather than encouraging them to work. Hence, one must ponder what view is actually appropriate for the sake of the children.

question: Learning about the past has no value for those of us living in the present. Do you agree or disagree? Use specific reasons and examples to support your answer.
essay:

question: Students from rural areas often find it difficult to access university education. Some people think that it should become easier for them to study at universities. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion?
essay:
Nowadays, it is acknowledged that students from suburban areas find it tough to receive higher education. Whether it should be made easier for them to access university education becomes an ongoing concern, which incurs a highly-charged debate.

Obviously, higher education opportunities bring about benefits to students in multiple ways. For example, to receive higher education becomes increasingly important to senior high school graduates, partly becasue it determines if they have the competitive edge in the job market, and partly because it is seen as a guarantee of a certain level of the mental ability, from the computer literacy that is required by the most employers to the capacities of acquiring new knowledge the soonest possible which is valued by the most workplaces . With a university degree, students from rural areas will obtain a job easily, thereby bettering their living conditions and their family as well.

Higher education also, however, tend to impose a heavy burden on their families since the relenting rise in the tuition fees which are - increasingly beyond those families’ ability to afford. In addition, with the mounting evidence, a university degree is not always a guarantee of seizing a decent job; therefore, their living conditions are likely to worse off by not able to earn back their tuition fee after graduation. In this way, some people argue, students from rural areas are not well-advised to pursue a university degree. But I perceive their desire to further their education should not be disrespected and the government should subsidise them to receive higher education.

In conclusion, university education should be made fair to everyone, predicated only on their academic performance and mental abilities, rather than their financial capacities and the government should subsidise those students in need.

question: It is a natural process in which animal species such as dinosaurs become extinct. There is no reason for people to prevent this from happening. Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
In recent times, there has been an ongoing debate regarding the natural extinction of animal species. A group of individuals believe that there is no reason for people to prevent this natural process from happening. However, others argue that humans should take measures to protect endangered animals and maintain biodiversity. Therefore, ahead of my opinion, both  views will be discussed further.

Examining the former opinion, the primary argument the supporters would put forward is that protecting endangered animals is necessary to maintain biodiversity. This is because every species plays an important role in an ecosystem, and the extinction of one species can affect the food chain. In addition, they also believe that preventing animal extinction can help maintain the natural balance of ecosystems. The reason is that the disappearance of one species may lead to an increase or decrease in the population of other species.

On the contrary, those in favour of the latter opinion have their own arguments. To begin with, their claim that natural processes can cause some animal species to become extinct. Such as dinosaurs disappearing after a natural disaster on Earth. Moreover,  many species are threatened by human activities. Including deforestation, hunting and climate change. Therefore, although natural extinction is inevitable in some cases, people can take effective measures to protect endangered species from human-related threats .

To conclude and offer my position, there are convincing arguments both for and against the extinction of animal species. Protecting endangered animals is reason for individuals .However, I certainly favour the former opinion because protecting endangered animals is important for maintaining biodiversity and the balance of nature.

question: Many people work from home using modern technology today. Some people think that only the workers benefit from this and not the employers. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
It is often argued that people who prefer to work remotely with the use of modern appliances benefit more than directors. I completely agree with this statement as  directors have more disadvantages , such as reduced productivity, motivation and collaboration of workers.

One major reason is that working productivity can slightly decrease over time. This is because employers can't control the working time of workers and how much time they spend working. For example, if online shopping assistants are irresponsible towards their work,  their trade will decrease day by day. Therefore, in this situation, employers don't benefit as they can't control the working process and productivity. Moreover, some employees may become distracted by household responsibilities, entertainment, or social media during working hours. This can make it difficult for managers to identify whether employees are completing their tasks efficiently or simply spending less time on important duties each day.

Another important reason is that workers' collaboration might decrease over time. The reason for that is that as workers operate remotely, among them, couldn't be collaboration ; consequently, competition between them will decline, and motivation too. For instance, if among sales operators there is no rivalry, the level of trade will decline over time. As a result, if the working process doesn't include competition and collaboration, workers' motivation will disappear. Additionally if workers don't communicate, they can not create new ideas and new projects.

In conclusion, I believe that directors don't earn many advantages from online work, this is because they can't control the working process and productivity and motivation among workers can decrease.

question: Some people believe that it is a good idea that old people continue to work if it is possible for them to do so. Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Several individuals feel that it can be a good idea if it is still possible for elderly people to continue having a job. However, I totally agree with this statement for some reasons, which I will elaborate on in my essay below.

On the one hand, it appears that the work society can be managed properly when there is an elder in a work environment, since they have more experience and have learnt from mistakes. This can lead people who struggle with their work to solve the problem easily through lessons from their elders. For example, in job fields such as data analysis, new employees tend to be confused about how to read statistical data, so that the senior workers who have more experience can give assistance based on their experience.

Furthermore, we can believe that this situation can have a big impact on young people's opinion, as elder people's productivity and commitment to the company tend to be seen as a good image that can be an example for young generations. They tend to complain about their work or even avoid some job fields. For instance, in Indonesia, many young people prefer having a job that is located in a building, particularly one that has many facilities, while older people would take any job which provides them with financial security as long as it still helps the family's income, never demanding a job that is prestigious.

To conclude, I totally agree that the presence of older people can benefit both in a work environment and in young people's mindset, as this can lead to having a prosperous society.

question: Some people think it is a good thing for senior managers to have much higher salaries than other workers in a company. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
In today's competitive world, it is widely believed that senior managers should have much higher salaries than other workers in the company. I disagree with this idea, and I tend to believe that an excessive difference between senior managers' salaries and employees' can have a negative impact on the productivity of staff, as they may think that their efforts are ignored by the company.

One of the major disadvantages of an excessive difference between head managers' income and staff's is that it can reduce employees' productivity in the workplace, as this may reduce their motivation to improve their essential skills for promotion. This is mainly because they may think that their efforts are not valued by the company. As a result, staff's job satisfaction declines and they just work to complete their tasks without any motivation for development and commitment to the company. For instance, huge salary differences in private companies often encourage employees to leave their jobs because they feel that their contributions are not recognised. Hence, excessive salary difference between senior managers and employees can lead to destructive consequences.

However, a reasonable salary difference can have a positive impact on the company's and employees' development because it can be an encouragement for staff to improve their essential skills while enhancing their productivity to promote their job position. Consequently, staff follow the company's goals while reinforcing their abilities. For example, in developing countries such as Iran, a higher salary is an efficient way to motivate employees to work efficiently and effectively in the workplace because it supports both the company's and staff's growth. Thus, a balanced approach to salaries can not only ensure the company's growth but also increase staff's motivation and job satisfaction.

To sum up, I firmly disagree with the existence of a huge salary difference between senior managers and employees because it can lead to inequality, which can decrease staff's productivity and motivation to perform their responsibilities more efficiently. Nevertheless, a reasonable difference can ensure both the company's and staff's development.

question: Some people think that having a high salary is the most important part of a good job. Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Nowadays, a new issue has arisen in our society: some people think that having a high salary is the most important part of a good job. I agree because a high salary helps us meet our needs for entertainment and household expenses. In addition, we should be smart, organised, and motivated to get a high salary in a big company.

To begin with, I agree that a high salary gives us an extra boost to reduce stress. This is because we can save, buy what we need, and meet our own needs. More specifically, if you have a high salary, you can go to malls and supermarkets and travel. However, you still have to meet job duties and complete everything by the deadline, especially at a big company. For example, last summer, I did my office work early to get a bonus and a promotion, and that helped me travel to Turkey to enjoy the views, like landscapes, waterfalls, and gardens, and to have new food experiences, and I spent around 5000 dollars. Therefore, a high salary covers around 75% of entertainment needs.

In addition, you should be cooperative to succeed in a big company. As a result, a high salary covers roughly 40% of my family's monthly needs.

In conclusion, both views show people's major needs in different aspects of life. Therefore, I believe that every family should get around 10,000 dollars for life’s  monthly expenses

question: Some people think that machine translation is highly developed in today's society. Therefore, it is not necessary for students to learn a foreign language. What's your opinion?
essay:
Nowadays, machine translation has become a popular topic of discussion, some people believe that not necessary for students to learn another language because of machine translation . I disagree with this opinion, this is because learning a foreign language is still important.

To begin with, learning a foreign language helps people understand other cultures in a deeper way. In other words, travel becomes easier because you can communicate  with local people more easily. For example, when you  speak another language, you can ask for directions confidently and avoid misunderstandings.

In addition, learning a new culture and its traditions increases your knowledge and helps you understand people better. As a result, you can adapt to a new environment more easily.

Another  important point is that learning a new language can change the way you think, because it lets you see things from a different perspective. As a result, this helps you improve and expand your knowledge. For instance, when you learn a new word in another language, it can show a concept that does not exist exactly in your language.

Moreover, learning a new language improves people's quality of life because it helps to provide opportunities , such as jobs. For example, a worker who speaks English and another language may help more customers or work with people from other countries.

However, machine translation sometimes gives a different or unclear meaning. Therefore, learning a  language from local people is more effective.

In conclusion, it is necessary for students to learn a foreign language because it helps to change their way of thinking and develop their knowledge , and even helps them understanding culutures. Also, learning these skills brings many benefits , such as increased opportunities for their students in future.

question: The availability of entertainment such as video games on handled devices are harmful to individuals and to the society they live in. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
In this modern era, the problem of means of entertainment has become one of the most acute problem to the general public. While some individuals argue that online games have negative impacts on people, especially the youth, and also on society as a whole, I partly disagree with this opinion. This essay aims to provide a comprehensive analysis of both views before offering my own viewpoint.

Examining the harmful effects that available online pastimes have, since they're addictive, various youngsters nowadays spend more of their time on screen rather than doing outdoor activities. As a result, they tend to be less active and  isolate themselves from family and friends. As a result, the relationship between them might be disrupted by a lack of interaction, leading to people living in a sedentary society. Furthermore, they might also be prone to have higher risk of certain mental and physical well-being issues due to the lack of exercise. To illustrate, too much screen time, understandably, drives them depressed and anxious. Therefore, it causes the downgrade of health, burdening the nation's healthcare system and public funding.

In contrast, negative or not, portable games are still advantageous in many ways. Individually, available entertainment serves as an emotional outlet for folks. This is because sorts of online entertainment in recent times is accessible as individuals can purchase them either in person at stores or on sales businesses' websites. Unsurprisingly, workers are able to decompress and unwind after a hard-working day. Because of that, they play a vital role in tackling depression and stress levels among employees, therefore increasing enterprises' productivity and profit,  prompting the country's economic growth. Moreover, teamwork pastimes are also a considerable way for residents to improve their soft skills. Due to the fact that team games, like Valorant or Free Fire, require a great need for communication, cooperation and creativity between teammates. This led to the creation of global communities, where players from all over the world are capable of connecting with each other through online forums or chats.

Overall, although portable means of amusement can create certain problems for either the general public or individuals, mentioning addiction, physical and psychological health risks, I believe that the benefits, particularly worldly bonding or economic enhancement, outweigh the drawbacks.

question: The best way to provide enough homes in large cities is to build tall apartment blocks. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
essay:
People believe that a housing shortage can be solved by constructing high-rise apartment blocks as a primary space-saving measure. While I agree that vertical residential offers a practical solution to central areas, I partially disagree that it is the most effective approach. This essay will explore both the merits of vertical housing and the need for suburban expansion.

On the one hand, building high-rise blocks offers a practical way to maximise residential living space. The reason is that vertical construction can allow city planners to integrate not only essential amenities but also provide accommodation for residents. For instance, modern apartment complexes in densely populated cities such as Saigon, Tokyo or New York often feature integrated commercial floors, enabling dwellers to fulfil their daily needs without travelling long distances. As a result, these complexes solve the living shortage and enhance convenience by keeping people close to their central workplaces.

However, the drawbacks of tall apartment blocks outweigh these advantages. This is because the concentration of thousands of households in a small area can cause a heavy burden on the infrastructure itself, such as overburdens sewage, electricity networks, and local roads. For example, in Hanoi, after the Hanoi Centre complex opened, it directly contributed to chronic traffic congestion during peak hours. In effect, relying solely on high-rise buildings threatens the overall quality of urban life and creates severe safety concerns for residents.

In conclusion, while vertical buildings can be a immediated solution for space limitation and daily convenience, they also contribute to overcrowding and safety risks. Therefore, the government should provide a solution combine with suburban development and transit expansion to ensure the sustain urban growth.

question: The plans below show the site of a farm in 1950 and the same site today.
essay:
The plans illustrate how Beechwood Farm has changed from 1950 to the present day. Overall, the farm has become considerably more commercial and tourist-oriented, while still retaining much of its original agricultural function.

In 1950, a large area on the northern side of the farm was used for grazing sheep, but this section has undergone substantial redevelopment since then. A camping field, a parking area and solar panels have been introduced in this part of the site. By contrast, the southeastern section has experienced relatively few changes. The farmhouse and chicken area have remained in their original locations, while the former barn has been replaced by holiday cottages. A new, smaller barn has also been constructed near the vegetable plot. In addition, the original tracks have been upgraded to roads, and a new route has been added to provide access to the barn.

Finally, the areas devoted to fruit trees, soft fruits and vegetables have remained largely unchanged. However, a farm shop has been added near the fruit-tree area, further reflecting the farm's shift towards commercial activities.

question: Financial education should be a mandatory component of the school program. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?
essay:

question: Art classes such as painting or drawing are important for children s development so it should be compulsory in high school.Do you agree or disagree
essay:
In  modern education, all the subjects are equally important for the yonge people , like art and painting, but some of them are not good at that. In this essay, I totally disagree with this statement, which i am going to prove later in this essay.

question: How much has the Internet has improved people’s lives? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
essay:
I believe the internet has greatly upgraded people's lives and has become inseparable from us. In this essay, I will explain three main reasons behind this phenomenon.

First and foremost, the internet brings huge job opportunities. In this modern era, recruitment advertising is mostly published online, whether on the company's official website or on job portals like LinkedIn or Jobstreet. This helps many companies share recruitment information and offers a feature for applicants to submit their applications. As well information provided, applicants can choose what kind of work that they want and suit their future career. Moreover, people have lots of choice applying to the job that offers good earnings. As a result, they can improve their life by choosing a company that supports their career and pays a high salary.

Secondly, the online world also creates easy access to knowledge. Today, there are many sources, such as YouTube, Instagram, or TikTok, that contain many useful and insightful pieces of information. For example, on YouTube, many doctors take videos and share health insights like how to build a healthy lifestyle through exercise, how to consume healthy food, and other relevant topics. Therefore, we can get free learning materials and make our life better by following the knowledge we get from.

Thirdly, the internet also makes it easy for us to reduce stress as we can get a cheap and wide range of entertainment. This technology drives massive entertainment content through international series, movies, and games. For instance, after a long day of work or school, we can maximise our free time by enjoying our favourite series on online streaming platforms such as Netflix, Disney, or HBO. So then, we can recharge our energy, regulate stress even better and improve our life quality.

In conclusion, I believe society's lives are highly improved by the existence of the online world. As the internet creates numerous opportunities, provides insightful advice, and produces various entertainment, society can get  better work, free knowledge, and a playful way to keep sane. So, the internet really improves people's lives a lot.

question: The world is experiencing a dramatic increase in population, which is causing problems not only for poor, undeveloped countries, but also for industrialized and developed nations. Describe some of the problems that overpopulation causes, and suggest at least one possible solution.
essay:
Nowadays, the population increase dramatically in most countries around the world. This is true for the developed and developing nations. Overpopulation cause a different number of problems. However, the government can solved these problems in many solution .

There are several problems that the raising number of people in undeveloped countries causes. Firstly, it is very difficult to provide enough food for all people. Secondly, the government limits the number of children per family to educate in school. In addition, in poorest countries usually have a lot of unemployment as well , and when the population increases, the number of unemployment increase . Finally, when too many people live on the land, the environment suffers.

There are different problems that overpopulation causes in rich nations. Firstly, it is very difficult for governments to provide helpful public services in overcrowded cities. Moreover, there is generally a higher level of crimes being committed, such as drugs abuse, murders, thefts, and ect . Which that often cause by the high rates of unemployment.

However, overpopulation problems in both nations have two main solution which they are deal by governments. Firstly, the government must educate people about limiting the size of the family. For example, in China they have a policy called “one child policy” which limits the size of the family to one or two children, and this is beginning to have an effect on the world’s most crowded nation.

To sum up, if the impulsive population increase continues, many more people will die of hunger in the poor countries. Also, in rich nations, the life in the cities will become more and more difficult.

question: In many countries, an increasing number of people are suffering from stress in their daily lives. What are the causes of this problem, and what measures could be taken to reduce stress?
essay:
In recent years, individuals have been suffering from stress in their daily lives. This problem is mainly caused by a busy schedule and work overload. To solve this problem, some effective measures have been implemented , such as regular exercise.

To begin with, the main reason why people are suffering from stress problems is their hectic schedule. Most individuals work 5 to 6 days per week from morning to late at night. They have pending tasks, which has to be finished in certain deadline. Apart from that, they may have to plan and prepare for their upcoming meetings and future tasks. For example, an employee who works 9 am to 5 pm in the office and he or she still has to finish their work after working hours to satisfy their boss's expectations, As a result, they have that mental pressure to complete their work, which ultimately causes stress.

To address this issue,  working out daily may help reduce stress at certain level. Individuals, who exercise daily have better mood and energy level. According to a study, when people work out daily,  their cortisol level drops, which is a stress hormone and relax your mind. For example, an employee who runs or weight lift daily has better focus and feels less mental fatigue. As a result, they spend their day very energetically with less stress.

In conclusion, having a busy schedule can cause an increase in stress level but this can be solved by exercising daily , such as running, jogging or weight lifting.

question: Many children today are overweight. This is a serious health problem. Give the reasons for this and give solutions to solve this.
essay:
The world is very different from the past, and that includes the eating habits of many children. Children today tend to be overweight. This is a serious health issue. This essay will examine the main reasons responsible for child obesity and offer solutions to fix this problem.

On the one hand, there are several reasons that contribute to child obesity. First,children eat far too much fast food. This type of food is unhealthy, high in calories, as well as trans fat. Also, they tend to snack on junk food daily. Second,children today do not engage in very much exercise. They lead a life filled with computers and video games. This existence lacks movement or physical activity. Finally, children today consume far too much sugar. They like to dine on sweets, candy and chocolate. As well, they drink different types of soda, which are loaded with sugar.

On the other hand, However there are several solutions to this problem. First, parents should provide healthier meals. They can give children more fruits and vegetables and limit junk food. Second, children should exercise more. They can play sports or spend more time outside. Finally, parents should limit sugary drinks and sweets. This can help children develop healthier eating habits.

In conclusion, child obesity is mainly caused by unhealthy food, lack of exercise, and too much sugar. Parents and schools should work together to help children live a healthier lifestyle.

question: Some young people are leaving the countryside to live in cities and towns, leaving only old people in the country side What problems are caused by this issue? What can be done to solve the situation?
essay:
In recent years, there has been a trend among young people to leave rural areas and move to urban areas to find a better life. This phenomenon creates several problems, such as an imbalance in the ageing population between the countryside and cities. The authorities should implement several plans to solve the problems faced ahead.

Massive urbanisation of youngsters leaves the ageing population behind in rural areas and causes a lack of labour resources capable of supporting economic growth. Many industries need people who have special skills and fresh knowledge from young people. As a result, industries can no longer find employees for run the business process and cause stagnation in economic growth. In addition, the trend of young people pursuing better lives in cities increase it population, that affecting the household expenditure. The price of houses, food, and other goods will increase alongside the rise of population in the cities.

There are some measures that can be implemented by the authorities to control these problems. Firstly, build more public infrastructure in the countryside areas and give a tax incentive for company who build a factory in the village. With both of these, companies would be willing to invest and build their factory in those areas, provide good employment for young people, and prevent them from moving out to cities.

In conclusion, although leaving the countryside gives several benefits in the short term for young people, it will lead to unintended consequences in the long term. To prevent that, the government needs to provide better job opportunities for youngsters.

question: TODAY MANY CHILDREN ARE OVERWEIGHT. THIS IS A SERIOUS HEALTH PROBLEM. GIVE THE REASONS FOR CHILD OBESITY AND GIVE SOLUTIONS TO HELP THEM.
essay:
Obesity is very common nowadays. It  has a tremendous impact on children. It has changed the way they  live. This essay will explain the reasons for child obesity and solutions to address this issue.

On the one hand, there are various reasons that lead to child obesity.  First, the main reason is the internet. For instance, children nowadays spend most of their time playing video games, which  means less time spent on sports and exercise.  Also, being in the virtual world reduces time spent in the real world, which is unhealthy.  Second,  many children today consume fast food and follow an unhealthy  diet. For example, many eat too much junk food and sweets, which are high in calories and low in nutrients. Finally, the lack of movement and physical activity can increase the risk of child obesity.  Many of them today lead a sedentary lifestyle.  Sitting in front of a computer or  television adds to the problem and increases their inactivity.

On the other hand, this issue has multiple solutions. First, socialisation is an incredible way to get rid of excess weight. In addition, children can socialise through group activities, helping them to stay healthy and keep in shape. Second, participating in organised games is an amazing way for children to lose weight. Last but not least, regularly following a good and balanced diet can change much in a child suffering from obesity. Parents should plan healthy home-cooked meals and not allow their children to eat restaurant meals.

In conclusion, it is clear to see that obesity is very harmful for children. Therefore, parents have to always keep an eye on their kids, especially  regarding  what they eat.

question: Millions of people every year move to English- speaking countries such as Australia, Britain or America, in order to study at school, college or university. Why do so many people want to study in English? Why is English such an important international language?
essay:

question: At many universities, live lectures are being replaced by recorded material which students watch in their own time. Do you think this is a positive or a negative development?
essay:
These days, many universities are stopping the live lectures and they are giving the recorded videos to the students, which they can watch at the home. In my opinion, this change has some good points and some bad points, but I think it is more positive.

Firstly, the recorded lectures are very convenient. The students can watch them at any time and they can stop the video and repeat the difficult parts, which is not possible in the class. This is very helpful for the students who are not understanding quickly. Also, the students who are doing the part time job or who are living far away from the campus can save the travelling time and use it for the study. Also they can watch the same lecture again before the examination, which is giving them more confidence.

Secondly, there are some problems also. The students are not meeting the teacher face to face, so they can not ask the questions immediately. Many students are also lazy and they are not watching the videos regularly, and then they are doing everything in the last week before the exam. Moreover, the university life is not only the study, it is also the friends and the discussions, and the recorded lectures are taking this away.

In conclusion, the recorded lectures are giving the flexibility to the students, but they are also creating the problems like the lack of the discipline and the interaction. Therefore I think the both systems should be used together in the universities.
