question: In many countries, public confidence in politicians has fallen sharply in recent decades. What has caused this loss of trust? How might it be rebuilt?
essay:
In these days, many people in different countries do not believe their politicians any more. In my opinion there are several reasons for this situation, and I will also give some ideas how the trust can come back.

The first and the biggest reason is the corruption. We can see in the news almost every week that some minister take money from a big company or give a job to his relative. When ordinary people who work hard and pay the tax see this, of course they lose the trust. Corruption is not a new thing, but now because of the internet everybody know about it immediately. Also, the politicians live in the big houses and they do not know the problems of the normal families.

Another reason is that politicians do not keep their promises. Before the election they promise many things, for example they will build new hospitals, they will reduce the price of the electricity and they will create the jobs. But after they win, most of these promises are forgotten and nothing is changed. In my country, for example, a party promised free transport for the students and after two years it did not happen. People feel that they were cheated, so next time they do not believe anything.

For rebuilding the trust, the politicians should be more honest and the government should punish the corruption strongly.

To conclude, the loss of the trust is mainly caused by corruption and false promises, and only honesty can solve this problem in the future.

question: Most people are now aware of the environmental damage caused by air travel, yet the number of flights taken each year continues to rise. Why do people keep flying? What should be done about this?
essay:
Nowadays a lot of people know that the airplanes are very bad for the environment, but in spite of this the number of the flights is increasing every year. In this essay I will explain why this happen and what we should do.

The first reason is that flying is very cheap now. Many low cost companies sell the tickets for a very cheap price, sometimes cheaper than the train. If a family want to go for holiday, of course they will choose the cheap option. Also flying is very fast. If you go to another country by car or by train it takes many hours or even days, but by plane it takes only two or three hours, so people prefer the plane because they do not want to waste their holiday in the travelling.

Another reason is that people think their own flight is not important. One person can think that if he does not fly, the plane will fly anyway, so there is no difference. Moreover many people must fly for their job or to visit their family who lives in the other country, so they have no choice. For example my cousin works in a company which has offices in three countries and he must take the plane almost every month.

In my opinion the government should put a tax on the flights and make the trains cheaper.

In conclusion, people continue to fly because it is cheap and fast and they think one person can not change anything, and the governments should use taxes to reduce this problem.

question: Traffic congestion is becoming worse in many rapidly growing cities. What do you think are the causes of this, and what solutions could be introduced?
essay:
Traffic jam is one of the biggest problem in the modern cities, especially in the developing countries where the population is growing very fast. In this essay I will explain the reasons of this problem and I will give some solutions.

The first reason is the rapid increase of the private cars. Nowadays, the car is not a luxury anymore and almost every family can buy one, so the number of the vehicles on the road is much more than before. Secondly, the public transport in many cities is very poor. The buses are old, they are always late and they are overcrowded, so people prefer to use their own car. Moreover, the road infrastructure is not developed enough. Many cities have narrow roads which were built many years ago and they can not handle the traffic of today.

There are several solutions for this problem. Firstly, the government should build more roads and flyovers to reduce the traffic. Secondly, the government should improve the public transport, for example by buying new buses and building the metro system. In addition, the people should use the carpooling or the bicycle for the short distance, and the companies can allow the flexible working hours so all the people are not travelling in the same time.

In conclusion, the traffic congestion is caused by the increasing of the cars, the poor public transport and the old infrastructure, and it can be solved by building more roads, improving the public transport and changing the habit of the people. The government and the citizens must cooperate to make our cities better.

question: In many countries, people are now living longer than ever before. Some people say an ageing population creates problems for governments. Other people think there are benefits if society has more elderly people. To what extent do the advantages of having an ageing population outweigh the disadvantages?
essay:
Recently,  people have longer life expectancies in many nations. Some people argue that they create many issues for governments, while others disagree with this perspective and they believe that it is beneficial for having increased number of old people in society. I agree with the latter view, and I strongly believe the advantages are way more than the drawbacks for raising of ageing of individuals.

There is no doubt that the growth of elderly people brings some issues to our society. This is because the increased demand for employment or a pension for living, but the support from governments is limited. For example, a person over 65 would refuse to retire, because he still needs the job for living, but his strength and ability are not suitable to serve as before. They also take over jobs from the youth. In addition, they are fragile to keep working, which is unsafe.

However, even with these countless drawbacks, active older people are beneficial for both their families and society. They could stay away from certain employment that is highly physically demanding. Instead, they could help young couples to take care of their grandchildren. Of course, they are welcome to share experiences in the work environment. For instance, some strong, aged folks spend one day a week as a salesman in grocery stores or daycares. These activities keep them happy and connected with others, which is crucial for their retirement lives.

In conclusion, problems of having those old individuals exist, but I strongly believe that they deserve a wise plan to help them to contribute their experiences and residual abilities, and they would be very happy to be needed.

question: It is common that in many companies people from different ages work together in a same team. Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantges?
essay:
It is true that now many companies hire employees from different age groups, and they often work together in the same team. The main advantage of this trend is that it fosters a rich exchange of ideas and perspectives. However, it may create conflicts at the workplace, especially when age‑related stereotypes and technical skills arise. I personally believe that teamwork increases collaboration and brings positivity to the workplace.

On the one hand, teamwork of different ages shows determination and collaboration for the smooth functioning of the company. Older employees usually have extensive knowledge and experience, whereas young people are freshly graduated and possess critical thinking along with innovative ideas, such as using AI to handle various operations at work. Their mutual efforts encourage them to take risky decisions and decide how to tackle challenging situations effectively. For example, in many IT companies, senior staff mentor fresh graduates during complex projects to improve the quality of their work and boost their confidence as well.

On the other hand, despite its advantages, this trend may also create several challenges when employees of different age groups work together. Older employees feel more satisfied and comfortable relying on conventional approaches, whereas young people prefer technology and advanced methods rather than doing work manually. These contrasting work styles can create conflicts at the workplace, reduce productivity, and may arise misunderstanding among them when they have diverse professional approaches. Additionally, age‑related stereotypes can make communication less effective, as young people feel undervalued, whereas older employees may feel ignored.

In conclusion, although working with employees from different age groups can sometimes lead to conflicts due to contrasting work styles and age‑related stereotypes, its advantages clearly outweigh the drawbacks. When older and younger workers collaborate effectively, companies benefit from a balanced mix of experience, innovation, and improved teamwork. Therefore, I believe that encouraging intergenerational cooperation can create a more positive and productive working environment.

question: Some companies monitor employees' activities while they are working, including their use of computers and communication systems. Do you think the advantages of this practice outweigh the disadvantages?
essay:
It is becoming increasingly common for companies to monitor workers' activities while they are working, including their use of computers and communication systems. Although this practice has some disadvantages, I believe that its advantages are considerably greater because it can improve workplace productivity and help companies maintain security.

On the one hand, there are some disadvantages associated with workplace monitoring. One major disadvantage is that it can reduce employees' privacy. This may happen because workers can feel that their activities are being watched continuously during working hours. For example, employees may feel uncomfortable if their computer use and workplace communication are monitored without clear rules. Consequently, they may feel less trusted and experience greater pressure at work. Thus, this is a genuine concern that should be considered.

On the other hand, I believe that the advantages are considerably greater. The primary benefit is that such checks can improve workplace productivity. Employees may be more careful about how they use their working time when they know that their activities are being observed. For instance, a company may monitor computer use to identify excessive social-media use during office hours. As a result, staff may focus more on their professional responsibilities. Furthermore, another important advantage is that these checks can help companies maintain security. They can identify unauthorised access or inappropriate use of computer systems. For instance, an organisation can examine its communication systems to detect unusual activities and protect important business information. Consequently, the risk of security problems can be reduced. Overall, I believe that the advantages clearly outweigh the disadvantages.

In conclusion, although the disadvantage of reduced worker privacy is a valid concern, I believe that the benefits of such checks are substantially greater. This is mainly because they can improve workplace efficiency and help organisations maintain security

question: Space travel has become possible for tourists, and offers an opportunity for ordinary people to travel into space. Is this a positive or negative development?
essay:
While space exploration has historically been limited to professional astronauts, commercial space travel is rapidly becoming a reality. In my opinion, the development of space tourism is largely a positive trend because it drives technological innovation and broadens human perspective, despite the environmental concerns it initially raises.

On the one hand, commercializing space flight acts as a powerful catalyst for scientific advancement. Private aerospace companies invest heavily in research to make rockets safer and more cost-effective, which accelerates breakthroughs in fields such as telecommunications, materials science, and renewable energy. For instance, reusable rocket technology pioneered by commercial ventures has drastically reduced the cost of launching satellites that monitor global climate change. Furthermore, this industry generates substantial economic growth and creates high-skilled engineering jobs.

On the other hand, critics argue that space tourism is a negative development due to its heavy environmental toll and socioeconomic inequality. Frequent rocket launches release significant amounts of carbon dioxide and black carbon into the upper atmosphere, potentially worsening global warming. Additionally, it currently remains an exclusive luxury for the ultra-wealthy, diverting financial resources away from pressing terrestrial crises like poverty and healthcare. However, history shows that early-stage technologies are often expensive and resource-intensive before becoming cleaner and more accessible to the general public over time.

In conclusion, although space tourism presents legitimate ecological and economic challenges, its long-term benefits in technological progress and inspiration outweigh the drawbacks.

question: Taking risks in both professional and personal life is important. Do you think the advantages of taking risks outweigh the disadvantages? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
essay:
Sometimes, life requires people to take risks in order to progress on both professional and personal levels. Nevertheless, the crucial question remains whether this growth is worth the potential risk. Personally, I believe that the advantages that will be gained outweigh the disadvantages. In this essay, I will explain my opinion and support this view with some relevant examples. 

To begin with, I will take the stock market as an example. Stock markets are always challenging as their prices are volatile, and most of the time require prompt decisions to seize the opportunities. Therefore, most business firms and banks have platforms which connect entrepreneurs and investors with the international markets and provide them with market trends, which enable them to plan and make informed financial decisions. Although the stock market is  unstable, it provides significant profits if the financial decisions are carefully considered. This example demonstrates how the benefits of embracing uncertainty in investment can lead to financial growth and outweigh the possible loss.   

Another common example is job offers. It is one of the common real-world examples of uncertain choice. Most recruiting companies offer job opportunities and give candidates strict deadlines to decide. Mostly, these offers are competitive and need individuals to either accept or reject the positions in a very limited time. This case also shows  the positive outcomes of accepting risks on a career path, such as promoting to a senior position or a dramatic salary increase. This career growth outweighs the possibility of drawbacks that might happen , like losing a job.

Although taking risks brought positive opportunities and a huge life change,  it has also drawbacks that require careful analysis for any uncertainty. Thus, our decisions should be informed, and we might sometimes consult experts to minimise the chance of failure and its consequences.

question: The rise of convenience foods has helped people keep up with the speed of the modern life style. What are the advantages of this trend? Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?
essay:
Nowadays, it has become easier to keep up with a fast-paced lifestyle due to the increasing availability of convenience foods. Although they are often accessible and affordable, I believe that the health concerns associated with this type of food and the low wages paid to employees in this industry outweigh the advantages.

One major advantage of ready meals is that it saves people considerable time while remaining affordable and widely available. It is particularly beneficial for individuals with fast-paced lifestyles, such as workers and travellers, who may not have enough time to prepare meals at home. Instead, they can quickly purchase ready-made food and use the time saved for work, travel, or other activities. Furthermore, prepackaged meals can be cheaper than purchasing fresh ingredients and preparing meals regularly, particularly when some groceries may expire within a few days. For instance, buying a salad from a restaurant can cost the same as purchasing four or more packets of instant noodles, making the latter a more affordable option for people with limited time or budgets.

On the other hand, the excessive consumption of convenience food can lead to various health problems. These products often contain preservatives, artificial colours, and inexpensive ingredients that allow them to remain fresh and affordable for longer. As a result, consuming them regularly instead of fresh food can negatively affect people's well-being over time. Moreover, the low prices of these products can also come at the expense of workers' wages, as manufacturers may employ low-paid workers to keep production costs down and maintain affordable prices. For instance, many prepackaged meals factories in the UAE employ migrants on relatively low wages to produce and export large quantities of goods to other Middle Eastern countries.

To conclude, even though ready meals are cheaper and easy to attain, I think that the health problems they may cause and the exploitative labour practices in the factories that produce these meals overshadow the advantages they offer.

question: Today more and more tourists are visiting places where conditions are difficult, such as the Sahara desert or the Antarctic. What are the benefits and disadvantages for tourists who visit such places?
essay:
Nowadays, an increasing number of tourists are visiting places with difficult conditions, such as the Sahara Desert and Antarctica. Although travelling to these destinations can provide unique experiences and educational benefits, it can also involve serious risks and high expenses.

One major benefit of visiting extreme destinations is that tourists can experience nature in a unique way. Unlike ordinary holidays in cities or popular tourist attractions, these places allow visitors to see unusual landscapes and wildlife. For example, tourists travelling to Antarctica can observe penguins, glaciers and other animals in their natural environment. Such experiences can also increase people's awareness of environmental issues and encourage them to protect nature.

Another advantage is that travelling to difficult destinations can help people develop confidence and independence. Visitors may need to deal with challenging weather conditions, long journeys and unfamiliar environments. Successfully managing these difficulties can be a rewarding personal experience. In addition, such trips can provide valuable knowledge about different ecosystems and cultures, particularly when tourists travel with experienced guides.

However, there are also several disadvantages. The most obvious one is the risk to tourists' health and safety. Extreme temperatures, dehydration, storms and difficult terrain can cause serious problems, especially for inexperienced travellers. For instance, a person travelling in the Sahara without sufficient water or proper guidance could become seriously dehydrated. Moreover, these holidays are often expensive because tourists may need specialist equipment, trained guides and carefully organised transportation.

In my opinion, visiting such destinations can be worthwhile if tourists are properly prepared and follow safety regulations. However, they should understand the risks and avoid travelling independently in dangerous environments. Tour operators and local authorities should also provide clear safety information and emergency support.

In conclusion, visiting places such as the Sahara Desert and Antarctica can offer unforgettable experiences, knowledge and personal growth. Nevertheless, the risks, high costs and challenging conditions mean that tourists need to prepare carefully before travelling to these destinations.

question: Some people say that the best way to improve public health is by increasing the number of sports facilities. Others, however, say that this would have little effect on public health and that other measures are required. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
essay:
Public health remains a critical concern for governments worldwide, and the role of sports infrastructure in promoting physical well-being is frequently debated. While expanding sports facilities can encourage active lifestyles, I would argue that a multifaceted approach combining infrastructure with education and policy changes is considerably more effective.

Advocates of building more sports facilities contend that accessibility is the primary barrier to exercise. When gyms, swimming pools, and playing fields are readily available within communities, residents are more likely to incorporate physical activity into their routines. Research consistently demonstrates that proximity to exercise facilities correlates positively with activity levels, particularly in lower-income areas where residents cannot afford private gym memberships. The visibility of these facilities also serves as a constant reminder of the importance of physical fitness.

Nevertheless, simply constructing buildings does not guarantee usage. Many existing sports centres operate well below capacity, suggesting that the barriers to exercise are psychological and cultural rather than purely logistical. People who work long hours may lack the energy or motivation to exercise regardless of facility availability. Additionally, public health encompasses far more than physical activity — nutrition, mental health, preventive healthcare, and pollution reduction all play vital roles that sports facilities cannot address.

In conclusion, while improved sports infrastructure forms one component of a public health strategy, governments should simultaneously invest in health education programmes, subsidise nutritious food options, and implement workplace wellness policies. Only through this comprehensive approach can meaningful improvements in population health be achieved.

question: In some countries, the use of surveillance cameras in public places is increasing. Some people think this is necessary for public safety, while others believe it infringes on personal privacy. Discuss both sides and give your own view.
essay:
In recent years, there has been a growing trend towards the installation of surveillance cameras in public spaces. Proponents argue that this is essential for ensuring public safety, as it can deter criminal activities and aid law enforcement in solving crimes. Conversely, critics contend that such surveillance encroaches upon personal privacy, as it monitors individuals' daily movements without their explicit consent.

Those advocating for enhanced public safety maintain that surveillance cameras, especially in densely populated urban areas where crime rates are relatively high, serve as a powerful deterrent. The presence of CCTV can discourage potential offenders and provide invaluable evidence for law enforcement, thereby reducing crime and increasing the likelihood of prosecutions. For instance, in many major cities, CCTV footage has been instrumental in identifying and apprehending criminals, leading to safer streets and a greater sense of security among residents.

On the other hand, opponents of widespread surveillance raise valid concerns about the erosion of personal privacy. They argue that constant monitoring infringes upon an individual's right to go about their daily life without being observed, creating a 'Big Brother' society where citizens feel uneasy and distrustful. Moreover, the financial burden of installing and maintaining extensive CCTV networks can be substantial, potentially diverting resources from other crucial public services such as healthcare and education. For example, allocating a significant portion of the budget to surveillance systems in a developing country could hamper progress in essential sectors, thereby affecting the overall well-being of the population.

In my view, while the enhancement of public safety through surveillance is important, it should not come at the expense of fundamental privacy rights. The key lies in striking a balance: governments should implement surveillance measures judiciously, ensuring transparency, and adhere to strict data protection regulations. Additionally, the operation of such systems should be subject to independent oversight to prevent misuse. By adopting a responsible approach, societies can reap the benefits of increased security while safeguarding the privacy of their citizens.

question: Some people believe that employers should invest more in training existing workers to use new technologies, while others believe companies should hire people who already possess the required digital skills. Discuss both views and give your own opinion
essay:
It is often argued that employers should invest more in training their existing workers to use new technologies, while others believe that companies should hire people who already possess the required digital skills. Both views have some valid arguments and can be supported for different reasons. However, I personally believe that employers should invest more in training existing workers because this can improve their employment opportunities and help them adapt to technological changes.

On the one hand, I believe that employers should invest more in training their existing workers to use new technologies. The primary reason for my view is that training can improve workers' employment opportunities. This is mainly because employees can gain new knowledge and skills through training, which can make them qualified for new tasks and positions. In other words, workers can develop the skills needed to remain useful in a changing workplace. For example, a factory worker may receive training in operating automated machines and learn how to use modern computer systems. As a result, the worker can continue working in the company and may have better career opportunities.

Furthermore, another important reason is that training can help workers adapt to technological changes. This is because machines can perform some traditional tasks faster and more cheaply than humans, which may reduce the demand for certain workers. For instance, a manufacturing company may introduce automated machines and train its existing employees to operate and maintain them instead of replacing them completely. Consequently, workers can adjust to technological changes and reduce their risk of unemployment. Therefore, I believe that training existing workers is the more beneficial approach.

On the other hand, some people believe that companies should hire people who already possess the required digital skills. The main reason for this view is that skilled employees can help companies increase workplace productivity. This is mainly because workers who already have digital skills can use new machines and software more effectively without requiring a long period of training. For example, a company introducing automated production systems may hire experienced digital workers who can operate the technology immediately. As a result, the company may complete more work in less time and improve its overall efficiency. Therefore, it is understandable why some people support this view.

In conclusion, although there are valid arguments in favour of hiring people who already possess digital skills, I personally believe that employers should invest more in training existing workers. This is mainly because training can improve their employment opportunities and help them adapt to technological changes.

question: Some people believe that fashion is a waste of money, while others think it plays an important role in society. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essay:
In modern society, with the rising dominance of capitalism and consumerism on cultural values and personal goals, it is impossible to deny the role of fashion in people's lives.

On one hand, a large number of people, mainly consisting of environmentalists and anti-capitalists, believe that constantly purchasing clothes is not only financially unwise but also that retail businesses overall endanger the environment. For instance, in recent years in Western and Northern Europe, sustainable and second-hand clothing options have gained popularity, while fast fashion has experienced a decline in sales. By choosing sustainable or thrifted clothing, people can reduce expenses while also benefiting the environment, among other advantages.

On the other hand, many individuals, movements, and establishments advocate for the role of fashion in society. They argue that fashion is more than just a product. Take runway fashion as an example: in high fashion and haute couture, clothes are regarded as art, each conveying a deeper meaning. It is similar to a precious painting on a wall, but instead of a canvas, the model serves as the canvas, and the colors are fabrics and accessories. Furthermore, fashion is connected to personal and social impressions. Research shows that people are more likely to trust someone in a tailored new suit rather than a person wearing an old or outdated suit in the corporate world. Even in personal life, many individuals express themselves through their fashion aesthetics.

To conclude, there are many controversial views regarding the worth and impact of fashion. I personally believe that fashion is one of the keys to unlocking human creativity and individual uniqueness. As a result, I agree that the impact of fashion in day-to-day life cannot be overlooked. Clothes should be appreciated as art, a social contract, an emotional outlet, and overall, a way of life.

question: Some people believe that studying at college or university is important for successful career. Others think that it is better to quit school and find work to gain experiences for a successful professional life. Discuss both these views and give your opinion.
essay:
While some would argue that studying at college or university is highly relevant for having a successful career, others would say that this path is not strictly required to achieve one's goals. In my personal view, choosing to pursue a degree and further studies in a specific field is certainly a rewarding experience, particularly considering the current job market, which has become increasingly competitive. This essay will discuss both points of view in this regard.

On the one hand, higher education and academic environments allow one to network and foster meaningful connections with scholars and experts early on. For instance, colleges and universities offer an array of different projects and initiatives for their alumni, which are often coordinated by leading professionals in their fields, granting them relevant opportunities to start building their experience. These opportunities, alongside the skills and technical expertise acquired during studies, are very important to early-career professionals when joining today's competitive and dynamic job market.

On the other hand, choosing not to chase a higher degree may also bring some benefits to one's professional journey. Although college and university are helpful in supporting the improvement of key skills, these environments could limit one's ability to develop skills related to more corporate-oriented spaces, which are often acquired through work experience in the field. For example, landing a role in a big company early in one's career may give them practical expertise and a set of contacts that would have been challenging to get from a purely academic environment, thus positioning them more strategically in the job market

In conclusion, choosing whether to seek higher education nowadays is definitely an important decision to make, especially for young people. In my opinion, universities and colleges offer relevant opportunities for early-career professionals, in which they can develop key skills in their field. At the same time, choosing not to join or quit the academic environment might also have its benefits depending on one's professional goals and desired paths.

question: Some people believe that university students should study whatever they like, while others think they should only study subjects that will be useful in the future. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
The issue of choosing university subjects has become widely debated. While some people believe that students should be free to study whatever they like, others argue that they should focus only on subjects that are useful for their future careers. In my opinion, students should have the freedom to choose their subjects. This essay will discuss both views before reaching a conclusion.

There are several reasons why allowing students to choose their preferred subjects is beneficial. The main reason is that they are more likely to stay motivated when studying something they genuinely enjoy. This is important because interest can improve concentration and academic performance. As a result, students may achieve better grades and develop stronger skills. For example, a student who is passionate about art may perform much better in design than in engineering. Another important benefit is that personal choice can help students build a career that matches their abilities. This can improve long-term job satisfaction.

However, there are also some benefits to studying subjects that are useful for the future. The main advantage is that these courses may provide better employment opportunities because many industries need workers with practical skills. For example, students who study nursing, engineering, or computer science may find jobs more easily after graduation. Therefore, it is understandable why some people support career-focused education.

In conclusion, both approaches have their own advantages. However, I believe that students should be allowed to choose subjects they enjoy because this can improve motivation and help them build a suitable career. Nevertheless, universities should also provide guidance about future job opportunities.

question: Some people think it’s better to choose friends who always have the same opinion as them. Other people believe it’s good to have friends who sometimes disagrees with them. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion. Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
essay:
It is an irrefutable fact that the company of the right person has a significant impact on an individual’s life. While some people argue that it is more beneficial to have friends with the same views than companions who disagree on certain aspects of life. I totally disagree with the latter view because friends with different mindsets may enhance cognitive ability and bring excitement in life. This essay will analyse my views using relevant examples to prove my arguments.

On the one hand, friends with the same beliefs can reduce complications and help make decisions faster by agreeing with a person’s views. To illustrate further, humans often make a decision instantly or choose an option quickly if they receive a positive response on a particular option out of numerous options. To exemplify, girls who go shopping with friends, who have similar choices on clothing and their designs, often finalise their dresses faster than if they go alone. Therefore, a company of people with the same opinions saves plenty of time.

On the other hand, people with disagreements on some aspects broaden their friends’ horizons by presenting a different opinion. To clarify, due to a colleague’s different opinion, a person feels the need to explore other available options, which results in increasing their knowledge and experience. For example, if a person gets contradictory reviews from his or her mates on a mobile phone before buying it, he or she will look around other brands’ phones. This will increase knowledge about phones. Furthermore, conflicting opinions often make conversation exciting and making choices based on different thoughts brings positive vibes in a friendship.

In conclusion, although people strongly contend that like-minded thoughts have greater benefits, I believe friends with different or opposite viewpoints are vitally important. They will not only bring a positive energy to the relationship but also provide opportunities to obtain more knowledge.

question: Some people think that in order to be successful in business one has to study at university, while others disagree. Discuss both views and give your opinion. Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your knowledge or experience.
essay:
Whereas some people assume that a university education is not an obligation to build a shiny business career, others believe that a major degree increases the chance of success. However, it is inevitable to mention that individuals with high-level education possess a favour in a business environment. This essay explains this view in detail.

First of all, there are many examples of success stories which include great achievements without holding a license degree, as some kick-start studies in their areas of interest from an early age. These are the self-educated types, because they experience lots of real-life cases within common practices. For instance, many individuals are able to learn coding or programming without spending time in the faculty through online teaching platforms and training programs, with a self-defined pace and control over studying. Hence, they work on a variety of assignments and problems, and prepare themselves for possible enterprise opportunities, since they can already analyse and practice daily tasks even before they turn 18.

On the other hand, students attend universities not only to gain technical competence in their subjects, but also to acquire some skills, such as discipline, how to approach complexity,  how to research effectively, and dedication to a purpose. These skills are the elements that today's business success in business demands. For example, employees with an academic background are significantly capable of task completion on time, attention to detail, finding root causes and possible ways out of their cases, and handing over the deliverables without giving up until the end. Thus, they seem to have advantages in their companies to get promoted and also earn higher salaries as a consequence of their accomplishments, which result from owning more versatility than non-graduates.

To summarise, although it is possible to become a winner in business without a bachelor's or master's diploma, universities teach other crucial skills which are required to be deemed successful. Teenagers should be aware of these skills, and so try to select and attempt one major subject, to expand their horizons for a considerable adaptation to their business lives and comprehension of what a rewarding business life needs.

question: Some people think that Olympic games are exciting events that bring other nations together. Others say Olympics is a waste of maney and the money could be better spent on other things. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essay:
Holding the Olympic Games requires a large amount of money. A certain number of individuals consider that these events contribute to togetherness globally. By contrast, others claim that the money spent on the Olympics ought to be channelled to other favourable areas. In my view, the Olympics are an excellent opportunity for societies, but there are some factors that cannot be overlooked.

In terms of tourism and culture, the Olympic Games bring millions of people to a particular region. This is the event that fans stop paying attention to each other's nationality and language, sharing the same excitement and emotions. Subsequently, fans initiate further communication, which enhances a sense of unity. Moreover, the teams that attend the Olympic Games can attract tourists to their countries, boosting cultural exchange. It is a clear example that  after a Uzbek boxer called Hasanboy Doʻstmatov won a gold medal in the Olympics in 2016, most people started not only supporting Uzbek sportsmen, but also the Uzbek nation and culture.

On the other hand, the Olympic Games are generally funded by the budget that is funded by taxpayers. As this event requires a large amount of capital for the preparation process, facilities for sportsmen, and awards for the winners, individuals may be disappointed with this inadequate spending. The citizens frequently claim that it is better to spend this money on improving healthcare services, education, and the environment.

In my opinion, the Olympic Games ought to take place in developed countries, such as the USA, Canada, and the UK. Regarding other countries, there are more valuable fields to invest in than the Olympics.

In conclusion, although there are certain drawbacks of holding the Olympic Games in terms of economy, it is the best opportunity to bring people together, since sport can attract different nations to one place

question: Some people think the government should provide free housing, while others believe it is not the government's responsibility. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
Whether the government should provide free housing to its citizens has been a subject of debate. While some people believe that housing is a basic human necessity and should be provided by the government, others argue that individuals should be responsible for securing their own accommodation. In my opinion, governments should assist low-income and vulnerable people with housing, but providing free homes to every citizen is neither practical nor financially sustainable.

On the one hand, supporters of free housing argue that everyone deserves a safe and secure place to live. Adequate housing improves people's health, safety, and overall quality of life. Without stable accommodation, families often struggle to access education, healthcare, and employment opportunities. Furthermore, vulnerable groups such as elderly people, individuals with disabilities, and low-income families may not be able to afford rising property prices or rental costs. Providing affordable or free housing to these groups can reduce homelessness and improve social equality.

On the other hand, many people believe that buying or renting a home is a personal responsibility. Governments already spend large amounts of public money on essential services such as healthcare, education, transportation, and national security. Offering free housing to every citizen would place an enormous financial burden on taxpayers and could reduce funding for these important sectors. Moreover, if housing were completely free, some people might become less motivated to work hard or save money to improve their living conditions.

In my opinion, the most effective approach is a balanced one. Governments should not provide free housing to everyone, but they should support people who genuinely cannot afford accommodation through affordable housing schemes, rental assistance, or subsidised home loans. At the same time, individuals who have the financial ability should take responsibility for meeting their own housing needs.

In conclusion, although safe housing is a basic necessity, I believe that providing free homes for every citizen is unrealistic. Instead, governments should focus their resources on helping disadvantaged people while encouraging those who can afford housing to become financially independent.

question: Some people want governments to spend money looking for life on other planets. Others, however, sink this is a waste of public money when there are so many problems on Earth. Discuss both views and give your opinion?
essay:
In the modern world, space exploration has become an increasingly important issue. While some people believe that governments should spend money on exploring other planets, others argue that this is a waste of public money when there are so many problems on Earth. This essay will discuss both views before giving my opinion.

On the one hand, investing in other planets offers a multitude of benefits that extend far beyond mere scientific discoveries, drive technological innovation, and improve human life. Firstly, space exploration can lead to important scientific discoveries and technological advances. For example, research conducted for space missions has contributed to advances in communication, medicine and transportation. Secondly, Earth has limited natural resources, and discovering resources on other planets could benefit humanity in the future. Consequently, the government should also invest in the search for life on other planets to capitalise on those benefits.

On the other hand, critics of the funding argue that the government should prioritise immediate global crises. The Earth is currently facing serious challenges such as poverty, disease, and climate change. Spending thousands of dollars to search for extraterrestrial life is a highly speculative endeavour that may never yield results; it also seems impractical given that millions of people lack basic necessities such as clean water and healthcare services. Therefore, opponents argue that the funds would be better spent domestically—supporting struggling families and protecting the environment—to stabilise lives in the immediate term.

In conclusion, both perspectives have their merits. However, I believe that while governments must prioritise addressing crises here on Earth, they should still allocate a reasonable and balanced budget to space exploration. This approach ensures that today's problems are addressed without sacrificing tomorrow's scientific progress.

question: In many countries children are engaged in some kind of paid work. Some people regard this as completely wrong, while others consider it a valuable work experience, which is important for learning and taking responsibility. What is your opinion?
essay:
Nowadays, many children involved in different types of jobs to have some kind of financial assurance for themselves. However, whether this is good for their development and personality is a controversial issue. I personally believe that paid works is harmful for children for several reasons.

It is said that children gain valuable experience in the work place. This may be true. However, I would argue that children are mainly employed in jobs that require manual work and are poorly paid. The recent statistics reveal the common tasks that children are assigned to are washing dishes, mopping floors or serving food in restaurants. Meanwhile, this kind of jobs actually do not provide children with necessary and useful skills to apply in their future carrer .

This brings me to the second point. Defenders of child labour argues that it is an effective method of learning. The point is children should be able to apply knowledge taught to them in a real life working environment. Although this is undoubtedly true, it also means that children may neglect the classroom study and even fail the class. The worst thing is yet to come. They may become so preoccupied with the benefits ahead of them such as small salary that they may leave school.

Finally, supporters say that it helps them to build responsibility in the family. They will understand how it is difficult to earn money and therefore have compassion for their parents. This is true to a certain extent, but may have a totally adverse effect on children. As children can make money at an early age, they would feel that it is appropriate to spend it on luxury things.

In conclusion, I think that parents should take measures to restrict their child from work, otherwise it would have negative consequences to their future.

question: In some countries children have very strict rules of behavior, in other countries they are allowed to do almost anything they like. To what extent should children have to follow rules?
essay:
Freedom plays a pivotal role in everybody’s life. We can see in today’s modernized era that nobody likes to be restricted, whether it is a child or an adult. Some people think that there should have some strict rules of behavior for children, but I disagree with this statement.

In other words _ we have to look for other aspects as well, like if we usually ignore our children’s bad habits, then they can't be good human beings in their future life. Moreover _ if we never draw attention upon the children’s main activities then they might end up in a bad company. They can know regarding the value of respect for their elders . They can know the importance of relationships. They can know regarding their cultural values as well.

In a nutshell, I would like to say that children should be teach the value of their customs, rituals and respect towards their elders for their future life, but most of the additional restriction should be being avoided . It would be better to make them good human beings in their future.

This is a good, well-written essay. Some sentences are too short and could be combined together to create a more complex structure. There is also some repetition of words, which should be avoided. Overall, nicely done.

I would like to learn which is the difference of the following words: illness, disorden and diseases. I am not sure if mental diseases is correct.

Mental illness is the correct term

question: Access to clean water is a basic human right. Therefore every home should have a water supply that is provided free of charge. Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
There is a perspective that every home should get a free water supply because everyone needs water to survive, and it is a basic human right. I strongly disagree with this view because many citizens could waste their free water for no reason. Thus, I support the idea that all residents should pay for the municipal drinkable water supply.

There is no doubt that clean water is a basic necessity for everybody to survive, but it is also a scarce product on the planet. Most people have access to clean water because our governments hired many employees to work on making the natural water drinkable and accessible. For example, raw water needs to be collected from a natural body of water and goes through many cleaning processes before becoming tap water. The whole supply system is supported by many workers and a huge amount of funds. Therefore, residents should contribute their efforts to maintain this system as taxpayers.

Furthermore, the supply fee should be paid based on the volume of usage. As a result, people have no reason to waste any clean water and start to consider it as a precious natural resource, even though it is recyclable. For instance, if the water is free, most folks would be careless of the consumption and keep taps open even if they do not need them. The wasted volume will dump into the drain without use, which could be saved for those people who suffered of scares of clean water in a drought area.

In conclusion, water is a vital natural resource that needs to be protected as well. Free access to clean water for everybody is an ideal dream, but it doesn't exist in an achievable reality. I support the authority make a legislation to let users pay for their water consumption. Ultimately, the clean water can be preserved for this thirsty crowd who have no clean water for drinking.

question: Nowadays environmental problems are too big to be managed by individual persons or individual countries. In other words, it is an international problem. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
An essential problem of the 21st century is world pollution. Currently the environment is so contaminated that urgent measures should be taken. A single individual cannot be blamed for the world pollution, however every person should take care of his or her habitat. In addition, it is vital that environmental issues are treated internationally.

Lately, many presentations, conferences and international summits are held to deal with waste treatment, recycling, and soil and water contamination. For sure joint efforts and consolidation can only help in the mutual war towards the ongoing environmental disaster. For instance, governments should offer support to companies and organizations, involved in manufacturing, industry or agriculture in order to find environment-friendly approaches. These could be special law regulations, recycling programs, helping courses in order to implement ISO certificates and many more.

However, the influence of individuals over environment should not be ignored. If we do not confess that our planet is our home, we will never be able to take adequately care of it. We have to contribute every day to the preservation of nature and environment. For example, always remember to save energy by switching off lamps, computers and everything that we do not use. Our next obligation is to separate waste and throw bulk only in the designated areas. Driving vehicles can also be environment friendly. For example, we have to avoid accelerating the engines too rapidly or using the air conditioning in the country, where it would be better to save energy and simply open the windows.

To sum up, environmental problems should be handled by local and international authorities as well as individuals. Every single person should take care of the environment, moreover we have to bring up our children to be conscious citizens of a clean and preserved planet.

question: Artificial intelligence is increasingly being used to make decisions in areas such as recruitment, education and financial services. Some people believe these decisions should be made entirely by humans. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
It is often argued that decisions in areas such as recruitment, education and financial services should be made entirely by humans. However, I personally agree with the view that artificial intelligence should be used to make such decisions because it can analyse large amounts of information quickly and reduce human error.

The primary reason why I agree with this view is that artificial intelligence can analyse large amounts of information quickly. This is mainly because AI systems can process thousands of pieces of data in a very short time, whereas humans may need much more time to examine the same information. In other words, AI can compare and organise a large amount of information more efficiently than people. For example, a company can use AI to examine thousands of CVs and identify candidates whose qualifications match the requirements of a particular job. As a result, the recruitment process can become faster and more efficient. Therefore, AI can be a useful tool for making decisions.

Furthermore, another important reason why I agree with this view is that artificial intelligence can reduce human error. This is because people may make mistakes when they have to analyse a large amount of information, especially when they are tired or under pressure. For instance, a bank can use an AI system to analyse financial information and identify unusual transactions or assess loan applications systematically. Consequently, some mistakes caused by human limitations can be reduced. Therefore, I strongly agree with this view.

In conclusion, I firmly agree with the view that artificial intelligence should be used to make decisions in areas such as recruitment, education and financial services. This is mainly because artificial intelligence can analyse large amounts of information quickly and reduce human error.

question: The Internet when used as a source of information, has more drawbacks than advantages. To what extent do you agree with this statement?
essay:
Some people believe that internet access creates problems. There are several possible reasons why it can happen.

Firstly, some data may be unverifiable. For example, everytime they search for a data, there would be lots of choices that would appear on the screen. They would not be sure if the information they are reading is accurate. Some sources may even have outdated informations . Secondly, some sites may be unreliable. For instance, people sign up on one site that sells goods online. The goods would be paid for by a credit card, but the purchaser would not receive anything. And finally, not everything is available through the net. When my friend had tried to research for some pictures of 18th century paintings, he did not find any results. Then he was told by his teacher that they would only be available in the library.

Others believe that the Internet is very useful and these are the justifications. Firstly, it is hard to get the same data, that is available through the Internet by other means. For example, if the directory information could not give me the accurate address and contact number of a place I want to visit, I normally check that information on the Internet. In just one click, I would get all the details of that certain company. Secondly, research becomes more comprehensive. For instance, I do not have to buy lots of reading materials to complete my research. Most of the needed information can be found if I have Internet access. And finally, data is easily compared and contrasted. I remember, my cousin researched a study about overweight children a decade ago and at present . He was able to finish his research in just one day, as compared to a week if he would not use the Internet.

In conclusion, let me reiterate that the Internet plays a big role in our life, because it makes data retrieval and comparison easier.

question: Environmental problems are too big for individuals or individual countries to address. Therefore, they can only be tackled at an international level. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Nowadays, as environmental degradation exacerbates at a rapid rate, many assume that environmental issues are nearly irreversible unless global citizens acknowledge and take measures to mitigate the crisis. This essay, from my point of view, agrees that only when individuals accept responsibilities in combating environmental issues can these issues be resolved.

Initially, the severity of the environmental crisis is high, and allocating adequate financial resources comes from international parties. Since environmental problems are on a global scale, efforts made by one particular country cannot lessen the issue if other nations are unwilling to take action. Furthermore, the substantial investment required to combat environmental issues can account for almost half of national expenditure if nations take up idle funds, which is vital for the development of the country. In addition, the internal government is not sufficient in spreading awareness to citizens globally. This is because regulations can only be effective within the country. In contrast, international organisations have the authority to set laws which take effect indirectly in external regions through taxes or similar measures.

On the other hand, environmental problems can be addressed locally through strengthening a country's domestic efforts. As citizens, local communities can adopt an eco-friendly approach by purchasing products that are guaranteed to produce the least emissions. Moreover, industries can import organic vehicles which comply with government regulations dedicated to protecting the environment and invest in sustainable methods such as maintaining forests. For instance, instead of relying on fossil fuels, industries can construct solar power systems to reduce carbon emissions.

In conclusion, although resolving environmental degradation can be approached internationally or domestically, I believe international organisations are more effective than local authorities, as their actions are more immediate and have a more widespread impact.

question: Fast food is now universally in most countries and is becoming increasingly poular.Some feel that this is positive trend,while others do not. What are your opinions in this.
essay:
Nowadays, fast food is one of the most accessible foods and is becoming dominant in the food market all around the world. A number of people see this trend as beneficial, whereas others consider it wrong. This essay will thoroughly discuss both views before presenting a personal opinion.

To begin with, most of the population today have intensive lifestyle, which makes time the most valuable currency. Due to this reason, the majority of individuals are not able to make and carry homemade food. Therefore, fast food, such as hot dogs, hamburgers, and cheeseburgers, can be a solution to this problem. Not only does fast food offer speed, but it also offers a variety of delicious meals with different kinds of fillings and flavours, attracting  people who are in a rush. Moreover, due to technology, people can get fast food delivered to their workplace or home without much effort. These reasons make fast food chains become more popular, and most business people are considering it as profiting field.

On the other hand, fast food poses a number of serious threats to society. First and foremost, fast food is prepared from unhealthy products, which contain a lot of sugar and fat. This may cause obesity, which is the most common health issue in the world. Additionally, an excessive amount of sugar and fat increases the risk of heart attack, high blood pressure and other types of illnesses. Furthermore, it is worth noting that the popularity of fast food may threaten traditional cuisine. If the majority choose fast food over traditional food, local restaurants may go bankrupt, which is bad for the local economy.

In conclusion, considering both perspectives, I firmly believe that the popularity of fast food is negative as it contains a significant amount of unhealthy substances.

question: Government should spend money on railways rahter than roads. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement.
essay:
The increasing demand for efficient transportation has become a major concern for governments around the world. As cities continue to expand and the number of vehicles on the roads rises, many people believe that more public money should be invested in railway systems rather than road construction. I completely agree with this view because railways offer a more sustainable solution to traffic congestion and environmental problems.

The first reason why governments should prioritise railways is that they are a more efficient form of public transport. Unlike roads, which often become overcrowded during peak hours, railways can transport a large number of passengers quickly and safely. This not only reduces travel time but also encourages people to leave their private vehicles at home. As a result, traffic congestion can be significantly reduced, and fuel consumption can be lowered. Moreover, well-developed railway networks contribute to cleaner cities by reducing greenhouse gas emissions and improving air quality.

Admittedly, roads are essential because they connect residential areas, villages, and industrial zones where railway lines cannot be built. Emergency vehicles, delivery services, and local businesses also depend heavily on road networks for their daily operations. However, constructing more roads is rarely an effective long-term solution because wider roads often attract more traffic within a short period. If governments invested more in modern railway infrastructure instead, people would have a reliable alternative to driving, leading to a more balanced and efficient transport system.

In conclusion, although roads remain an indispensable part of a country's transportation network, I believe that governments should allocate a larger proportion of their budgets to railway development. Such an investment would reduce traffic congestion, protect the environment, and improve the overall quality of public transportation. Therefore, giving greater priority to railways would benefit both current and future generations.

question: In some countries, there are many social problems involving teenagers. This is because parents spend much of their time at work not at home. Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Some people believe that teenagers face social problems because their parents spend most of their time at work. I agree with this view because children need proper guidance and attention during their crucial years.

To begin with, the primary reason is that parents are often busy with work and do not have enough time to spend with their children. When they return home from work, they are often tired and exhausted, so they may not have enough energy to play with their children or listen to how they spent their day. Therefore, due to a lack of parental attention, some teenagers may become involved in social problems such as drug use and illegal activities. For example, teenagers who do not receive enough attention at home may spend more time with negative peer groups and develop harmful habits.

Moreover, parents may be too busy with their own lives to monitor their children's activities. They may not know what their children are watching on their phones or who their friends are. Nowadays, social media platforms can also contribute to teenagers becoming involved in social problems. When nobody monitors teenagers or provides guidance on how to use these platforms responsibly, they may be exposed to harmful or misleading content. As a result, teenagers may be negatively influenced and make inappropriate decisions because they lack proper guidance from their parents.

In conclusion, when parents spend most of their time at work rather than with their children, teenagers may not receive enough attention and guidance. Consequently, they may be more likely to become involved in social problems.

question: Nowadays, international tourism is the biggest industries in the world. Unfortunately international tourism creates tension rather than understanding between people from different culture. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
It is often argued that international tourism, as the largest industry worldwide, causes tension between individuals from different cultures instead of fostering more understanding. While some people agree with this idea, I completely disagree with this view. This essay will explain the reasons for my opinion.

There are several reasons why I disagree with this view. One of the main reasons is that international tourism contributes to the exposure of different cultures. This means that individuals from different places can find shared interests with other people. In practical terms, it can make it easier for them to have better communication with others. As a result, countries and their governments can have peaceful relationships. For example, countries whose communities are connected because of tourism usually have better international interactions.

Another important factor is that this matter causes a better understanding of the positive and negative points of the host country’s culture and the tourists’ countries. This is particularly beneficial because both sides would be able to improve their cultures. As a practical consequence, the communities may find it easier to eliminate wrong traditional behaviours and be accepted by the rest of the world. If this trend is accepted, it is likely to lead to the elimination of superstitions from different cultures. For instance, with the help of mutual understanding caused by tourism, the cultural behaviours of many societies have been improved , and they can communicate more effectively with foreign people.

In conclusion, I completely disagree with this idea due to points such as different cultures' exposure and the possibility of evaluating cultural behaviours. Overall, this approach can have long-lasting and widespread positive effects on the societies.

question: Prison is the common way in most countries to solve the problem of crime. However, a more effective solution is to provide people a better education. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
In the modern era, crime has become a major issue in society. While it is argued that prison is the most prevalent method of punishment, others believe that investing more heavily in education prevents the problem of crime. I firmly agree that  improved education may help tackle this issue, while prisons are often ineffective for rehabilitation.

Governments should invest more in education for younger generations in order to reduce the level of crime. Providing quality education may address many underlying factors

that can lead to criminal behaviour, such as poverty, ignorance, and lack of opportunities. It means that the enhanced education can help students to develop critical thinking and decision-making skills, which can deter individuals from engaging in criminal activities. For example, teachers can provide practical learning experiences and teach financial literacy, conflict resolution, and vocational skills to help young people find employment instead of turning a crime. Moreover, better education leads to  socio-economic growth. By promoting more opportunities, an educated population is more likely to pursue higher education , which enables them to build their own businesses or companies, contributing to national economic development. As a result, delivering  improved education is one of the most preventive approaches to reducing crime.

One of the main reasons why imprisonment can be ineffective is that often prisoners may reoffend after serving their sentences. It often fails to teach positive skills because this type of punishment only discourages criminal behaviour temporarily. If prisoners did not gain useful skills and live in a negative environment, they are likely to commit a crime again. Therefore, prison is not the best way to achieve  rehabilitation.

In conclusion, investments in schooling provide more effective solutions related to this problem, whereas  imprisonment can lead to  negative consequences, such as higher rates of re-offending

question: Some people believe that restoration of old building costs too much. We should demolish them and build new one instead. Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
There is an ongoing debate about whether demolishing and rebuilding are more effective methods than restoration. While a significant number of people believe that reconstruction requires an excessive amount of capital, others argue that destroying and building a new building provides an optimal solution. In my opinion, the decision should depend on the building's significance: structures with cultural or historical value should be restored, while those posing safety risks, such as fire hazards, should be demolished and rebuilt.

On the one hand, ancient buildings have a great impact on society, as they reflect their culture and tradition. Although restorations require an enormous amount of capital cost, these buildings are distinguished examples of old civilisations' artistic expression, which in turn attracts a considerable number of tourists' attention to visit them. To illustrate, instead of choosing the cheaper option of demolishing and rebuilding, a new church, Montreal's Notre Dame church has been restoring because it has artistic pillars and carvings, drawing tourists' attention from across the world, which in turn boosts the government's economy. Thus, there is a trade-off between restoration and reconstruction, which can compansate high restoration costs.

On the other hand, ancient buildings have  a variety of considerable risks during a series of natural catastrophes, while new buildings are more robust to them. Since old buildings, such as houses and governmental buildings, were made of wood and non-resilient materials, when advanced construction technology was not available at the time. For instance, Istanbul often faces cases of burning old buildings because these were made from wood in the past, and they start a demolition and rebuilding campaign to eliminate fire risks. Hence, rebuilding solutions can prevent cities from a variety of risks rather than restoring them.

In conclusion, restoring and reconstructing can provide different types of opportunities for authorities. Although restoring maintains society's cultural heritage, rebuilding strengthens old buildings' stability and resilience.

question: Some people think that older and more experienced employees are useful for a company. Others feel that modern younger employees are better for an organisation. do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Some people lean towards hiring older, experienced employees to avoid costly mistakes, while others prefer younger employees for their knowledge of new technology. In my view, both groups are valuable, since a company benefits from experience as well as fresh technical skills.

When someone applies for a job, one of the first things employers ask about is their previous work experience. This shows how highly experience is valued in the workplace, and some companies will not even consider candidates who do not have it, regardless of their qualifications. Experience might help avoid costly mistakes and reduces the risk involved in important decisions. For example, many companies promote someone who already has experience within the company to a managerial role. That saves the company a significant amount of time and money, since someone who has experience usually already knows the clients, system and most importantly the staff.

However, younger employees bring skills that many experienced staff lack, particularly with new technology. Having grown up with smartphones and the internet, they often adapt to new software far more quickly than older colleagues. They are also more likely to suggest fresh ideas, since they are not attached to the way things have always been done. This matters because companies that target younger consumers depend on staff who understand them, and younger employees are often best placed to do so.

In conclusion, I believe both older and younger employees are valuable. Experience helps companies avoid costly mistakes, while younger workers keep them up to date with new technology, so the most successful organisations employ a mix of both.

question: Some people think that the government is wasting money on the arts and that this money could be better spent elsewhere. To what extent do you agree with this view?
essay:
Admittedly, art plays a crucial role in society, and it is often argued that investing in this field is not more profitable for the state; there will be a greater output elsewhere.  Although some might agree with this statement, I fully disagree with it inasmuch as art has a prevalent appeal to both the public and the government. This essay will examine these points of view in detail.

To begin with, one of the principal reasons for the government’s support is the emotional and intellectual influence of art on individuals. Dignitaries indirectly expand residents’ horizons, improve their mental health and enhance cultural development by financing art institutions such as galleries, exhibitions and restoring sculptures that are looked at by wide audience. For example, by imposing incentives on museums, students can visit them for free; consequently, teenagers strengthen their knowledge and absorb cultural heritage. Moreover, visual forms of art help to unwind their thoughts. Hence, this reason almost single-handedly expresses my view about the importance of spending money on this field.

Another primary reason to invest funds is the opportunity for tourism development that brings significant profit to the government’s budget. By providing remarkable exhibitions and supporting local artists, governments raise awareness of local culture; in addition, it strikes a chord with tourists. To illustrate, Italy provides memorable fashion galleries and commercials every year, and it attracts a significant number of visitors; ultimately, the country boosts hotel and retail sales. Thus, this reason justifies my opinion that governments can also raise their national level by investing money in art masterpieces.

In conclusion, I strongly believe that money spent on the arts is not wasted but a worthwhile investment, as it promotes cultural education, attracts foreign visitors, and allows governments to derive profit from it.

question: Some people think that the increasing use of computers and mobile phones nowadays has unwanted effects on young people's reading and writing skills. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
It is often claimed that the growing dependence of young people on computers and mobile phones is having a damaging effect on their ability to read and write properly. I partly agree with this view, since the impact depends largely on how these devices are actually used.

The main risk is that young people stop practising writing altogether, and any skill left unused eventually fades. Some students let artificial intelligence do their research or presentation, which can save them time at the cost of quality. A student may submit excellent essays all year, then struggle to produce a single paragraph in an examination hall. Moreover, if a student has poor writing skills they can get lower grades without artificial intelligence help. As a result, artificial intelligence can produce people who are not able to write and can damage society with uneducated people.

However, if students use artificial intelligence correctly, it would not affect the quality of their work. When writing about personal experience, for example, the technology has clear limitations, though it can still help students clarify their own ideas. Some students do not have a choice about using artificial intelligence with tight deadlines. It can help them save a significant amount of time to focus on creating new ideas or solving complex problems.

In conclusion, I partly agree that technology is harming young people's literacy. The damage comes not from the devices themselves but from students who let them do the thinking, while those who use them as a tool lose nothing.

question: Technology is becoming progressively universal. In the fullness of time, classroom teachers will be totally substituted for technology. Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
In the present world, the usage of computers is constantly on the rise. Even classrooms are among the many places that enjoy the usage and benefits of automation. It is disputed that classroom teachers will be totally substituted by machinery. Analysing the incapability of disciplining classroom students with robotics, as well as the limitations in the learning process of students taught with technology, will prove this.

Firstly, a robotic teacher made with artificial intelligence would lack sufficient control over its classroom students.
